title.zh: 卷七 本紀第七 真宗二
title.raw: 卷七 本紀第七 真宗二 Volume 7 Annals 7: Zhenzong 2

sentences.zh: 六年春二月戊寅，幸飛山雄武營，觀發機石、連弩，遂宴射潛龍園。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, second month, day wuyin, the emperor visited Feishan Xiongwu Camp, viewed the launching of catapults and repeating crossbows, then feasted and shot arrows at Qianlong Garden.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, second month, day wuyin of year six: the emperor inspected Feishan’s Xiongwu Camp, watched catapults and repeating crossbows fired, then held an archery feast in Qianlong Garden.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以京東西、淮南水災，遣使振恤貧民，平決獄訟。

translations.literal: Day jimao: because of floods in eastern and western Jing and in Huainan, envoys were sent to relieve the poor and to settle lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, floods in Jing east and west and in Huainan prompted envoys to aid the destitute and clear court backlogs.

sentences.zh: 幸北宅視德潤疾。

translations.literal: He visited the Northern Residence to see Derun’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: He called at the Northern Residence to visit the ailing Derun.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以西涼府六谷首領潘羅支為朔方軍節度、靈州西面都巡檢使。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Pan Luozhi, chief of the Liugu tribe of Xiliang prefecture, was made military commissioner of Shuofang and western Lingzhou frontier inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Pan Luozhi, head of Xiliang’s Liugu people, received Shuofang command and the western Lingzhou inspection post.

sentences.zh: 甲申，封賢懿長公主為鄭國長公主。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Princess Xianyi the Long was enfeoffed as Princess of Zheng the Long.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Princess Xianyi was raised to Princess of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 蕃部葉市族囉埋等內附。

translations.literal: Fan tribesmen Luomai and others of the Yeshi clan submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Luomai of the Yeshi Fan clan and others came in.

sentences.zh: 己丑，德潤卒。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Derun died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Derun died.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，屯田員外郎盛梁坐受賕枉法，流崖州。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Sheng Liang, outer-office clerk of the farming colonies, took bribes and perverted the law; he was banished to Yazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, colony clerk Sheng Liang was convicted of bribery and sent to Yazhou.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯朔，欽州言交州八州使黃慶集等來歸。

translations.literal: Third month, first day xinmao: Qin prefecture reported that envoys Huang Qingji and others of Jiaozhou’s eight prefectures had come to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, new moon xinmao: Qinzhou reported Jiaozhou’s eight-prefecture envoys, led by Huang Qingji, seeking allegiance.

sentences.zh: 石、隰都巡檢使言綏州東山蕃部軍使拽臼等內屬。

translations.literal: The Shi and Yin frontier inspectors reported that Fan military commissioner Zhuaijiu of eastern Suizhou and others had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shi and Yin inspectors reported Suizhou’s eastern Fan commander Zhuaijiu and others had defected inward.

sentences.zh: 己酉，餞种放還山。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: a farewell was held for Zhong Fang returning to the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the court saw Zhong Fang off to his mountain retreat.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸惟吉第視疾。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the emperor visited Weiji’s residence to see his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, he called on the sick Weiji.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幸元份宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the emperor visited Yuanfen’s palace to see his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, he visited the ailing Yuanfen.

sentences.zh: 四月，李繼遷寇洪德砦，蕃官慶香、白乙者多慶等擊走之。

translations.literal: Fourth month: Li Jiqian raided Hongde Fort; Fan officers Qingxiang, Bai Yiduo, and Duo Qing drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Li Jiqian struck Hongde Fort; Fan officers Qingxiang, Bai Yiduo, and Duo Qing repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 以慶香等領刺史。

translations.literal: Qingxiang and the others were made prefects.
translations.idiomatic: Qingxiang and his fellows received prefectural rank.

sentences.zh: 契丹來侵，戰望都縣，副都部署王繼忠陷於敵，發河東廣銳兵赴援。

translations.literal: The Khitan invaded; battle was joined at Wangdu county; Vice frontier commissioner Wang Jizhong was captured by the enemy; Hedong’s Guangrui troops were sent to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan forces invaded; at Wangdu, deputy commissioner Wang Jizhong fell into enemy hands, and Hedong’s Guangrui army marched to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，信國公玄祐薨。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Duke of Xin Xuanyou died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Duke of Xin Xuanyou died.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiawu: Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，錄望都戰沒將士子孫。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the descendants of officers killed at Wangdu were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, registers were opened for the orphans of Wangdu’s fallen.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，鎮州副都部署李福坐望都之戰臨陣退血刃，削籍流封州。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Li Fu, deputy frontier commissioner of Zhenzhou, for withdrawing bloodied from the Wangdu battle, was struck from the rolls and banished to Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhenzhou’s Li Fu, who had left Wangdu wounded but retreating, was disenrolled and exiled to Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 京城疫，分遣內臣賜藥。

translations.literal: Plague in the capital; eunuchs were sent out to bestow medicine.
translations.idiomatic: An epidemic struck the capital; palace eunuchs distributed medicine house to house.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，詔命官流竄沒嶺南者，給緡錢歸葬。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao: an edict ordered that officials banished and dying in Lingnan be given silk cash for burial and repatriation.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingmao: exiles who died in the far south were to receive cash for burial and return of their remains.

sentences.zh: 豐州瓦窯沒劑、如羅、昧克等族以兵濟河擊李繼遷，敗之。

translations.literal: The Wayao, Ruluo, and Meike clans of Fengzhou crossed the river with troops to strike Li Jiqian and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Fengzhou’s Wayao, Ruluo, and Meike tribes crossed the river, beat Li Jiqian, and drove him back.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，隴山西首領禿逋等貢馬，願附大兵擊賊。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: chieftains including Tutong of western Long submitted horses and asked to join the great army against the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Longxi chiefs led by Tutong presented horses and offered to fight the rebels under imperial command.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，寇準為三司使。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Kou Zhun became commissioner of the three departments.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Kou Zhun took the three departments.

sentences.zh: 復鹽鐵、度支、戶部副使。

translations.literal: The vice commissioners of salt iron, revenue, and population were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy posts for salt-iron, revenue, and population were reinstated.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，兗王元傑薨。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guichou: Prince of Yan Yuanjie died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guichou: Prince of Yan Yuanjie died.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengwu: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengwu: Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 辛未，原、渭等州言西蕃八部二十五族納質來歸。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Yuan, Wei, and other prefectures reported that twenty-five clans of the western Fan’s eight tribes had sent hostages and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Yuan, Wei, and others reported twenty-five western Fan clans of eight tribes had given hostages and submitted.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔：環慶秋田經寇踐傷者，頃賜粟十五斛；

translations.literal: Day bingzi, edict: for autumn fields in Huan and Qing trampled by raiders, grain was to be given at once—fifteen hu per household;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict promised fifteen hu of grain to Huan-Qing households whose autumn fields raiders had ruined;

sentences.zh: 民被掠者，口賜米一斛。

translations.literal: for people carried off, one hu of rice per person.
translations.idiomatic: and one hu of rice for every person taken captive.

sentences.zh: 蠲棣州民租十之三。

translations.literal: A third of Di prefecture’s land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Di prefecture’s land tax was cut by a third.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，蒲端國獻紅鸚鵡。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jichou: Pu’anduan presented a scarlet parrot.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jichou: Pu’anduan sent a scarlet parrot.

sentences.zh: 丙申，出內府繒帛，市穀實邊。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: silks from the inner treasury were released to buy grain for the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, palace silks were sold to purchase frontier grain.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以呂蒙正為太子太師、萊國公。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Lü Mengzheng was made grand mentor of the heir and Duke of Lai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Lü Mengzheng became heir’s grand mentor and Duke of Lai.

sentences.zh: 十月丁丑，狐出皇城角樓，獲之。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day dingchou: a fox appeared at the corner tower of the imperial city; it was caught.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingchou: a fox at the palace corner tower was captured.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，給軍中傳信牌。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: signal plaques were issued to the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, armies received courier signal plaques.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，慮囚，雜犯死罪以下遞減一等，杖釋之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guisi: prisoners were reviewed; mixed offenses below death were reduced one degree and those under the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guisi: a prison review cut mixed crimes below capital by one grade and freed those due only flogging.

sentences.zh: 苦寒，令諸路休役兵。

translations.literal: In bitter cold, corvée troops on all circuits were stood down.
translations.idiomatic: In severe cold, labor drafts on every circuit were halted.

sentences.zh: 己亥，閱捧日軍士教三陣于崇政殿。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the emperor reviewed Penglai troops drilling three formations in Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, he watched Penglai guards rehearse three battle arrays in Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，幸大相國寺。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the emperor visited Daxiangguo Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, he went to Daxiangguo Monastery.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，雨木冰。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: rain froze on the trees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, glaze ice coated the trees.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，有星孛于井、鬼。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: a comet appeared in Jing and Gui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, a comet blazed in the Well and Ghost lodges.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，遣使西北，勞賜將士。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengshen: envoys were sent northwest to comfort and reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengshen: envoys went northwest to salute and reward the armies.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔求直言。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: an edict sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the throne called for frank memorials.

sentences.zh: 西面部署言李繼遷攻西涼，知府丁維清沒焉。

translations.literal: The western frontier commissioner reported that Li Jiqian attacked Xiliang and prefect Ding Weiqing perished.
translations.idiomatic: Western headquarters reported Li Jiqian’s assault on Xiliang and the death of prefect Ding Weiqing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以李繼隆為山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Li Jilong was made military commissioner of Shannan East.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Li Jilong received Shannan East command.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，萬安太后不豫，詔求良醫。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Ten Thousand Peace Empress Dowager fell ill; an edict sought skilled physicians.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Ten Thousand Peace Dowager sickened; physicians of renown were summoned.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，赦天下，死罪減一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: amnesty for the empire; death sentences reduced one degree, exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, a general amnesty cut capital crimes one grade and freed all below exile.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西涼府暨龍野馬族、三佛齊、大食國來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Xiliang prefecture together with the Longye wild-horse tribe, Srivijaya, and the Dashi state came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year brought tribute from Xiliang, the Longye horse people, Srivijaya, and the Arabs.

sentences.zh: 河北、興元府、遂、郢州大熟。

translations.literal: Hebei, Xingyuan prefecture, and Sui, Ying prefectures had great harvests.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei, Xingyuan, Sui, and Ying reported bumper crops.

sentences.zh: 景德元年春正月丙戌朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: Jingde year one, spring, first month, day bingxu new moon: great amnesty and era change.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 1, spring, new moon bingxu: universal pardon and a new reign title.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，麟府路言契丹言埿族拔黃三百餘帳內屬。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Qinfu circuit reported that the Khitan Yanqi tribe’s Huang clan, more than three hundred tents, had submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Qinfu reported over three hundred tents of the Khitan Yanqi Huang clan had defected.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，幸天駟監，賜從官馬。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the emperor visited the imperial stud and bestowed horses on his attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, he inspected the imperial stud and gave horses to his suite.

sentences.zh: 丙申，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the capital quaked.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔：民間天象器物讖候禁書，並納所司焚之，匿不言者死。

translations.literal: Day xinchou, edict: popular works on celestial phenomena, prognostication, and forbidden books were all to be surrendered to the authorities for burning; those who hid them and did not report were to die.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict demanded all private star-charts, omens, and banned texts be turned in for burning—concealment was capital.

sentences.zh: 石、隰州言河西蕃部四十五族首領率屬內附。

translations.literal: Shi and Yin prefectures reported that forty-five tribal chiefs of the Hexi Fan had led their people to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Shi and Yin reported forty-five Hexi Fan chiefs had brought their clans in.

sentences.zh: 京師地再震。

translations.literal: The capital was shaken again by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: The capital shook again.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，廢高州。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Gaozhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Gaozhou was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁未，京師地復震。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the capital was shaken by earthquake again.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, another tremor hit the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬子，開定州河通漕。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Dingzhou’s river was opened to connect the grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Dingzhou’s canal was dredged for grain barges.

sentences.zh: 二月，環慶部署言西涼府潘羅支集六谷蕃部合擊李繼遷敗之，繼遷中流矢死。

translations.literal: Second month: the Huanqing commissioner reported that Pan Luozhi of Xiliang had gathered the Liugu Fan to join in attacking Li Jiqian, defeated him, and Jiqian died of an arrow wound.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Huanqing reported Pan Luozhi of Xiliang rallied Liugu Fan, routed Li Jiqian, and Jiqian died of an arrow.

sentences.zh: 羅支使來獻捷。

translations.literal: Luozhi’s envoy came presenting a victory report.
translations.idiomatic: Luozhi’s messenger brought news of victory.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太常卿張齊賢為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Zhang Qixian, director of the court of sacrifices, became minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, ritual chief Zhang Qixian became minister of war.

sentences.zh: 冀、益、黎、雅州地震。

translations.literal: Ji, Yi, Li, and Ya prefectures were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, Yi, Li, and Ya quaked.

sentences.zh: 三月，威虜軍守將破契丹於長城口，追北過陽山，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: Third month: the Weilu army garrison commander defeated the Khitan at the Great Wall pass, pursued north beyond Yangshan, and took many heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Weilu’s garrison beat the Khitan at Great Wall pass, chased them past Yangshan, and took heavy spoils.

sentences.zh: 柳谷川蕃部入寇，麟府擊敗之，擒千餘人。

translations.literal: Fan tribes of the Willow Valley entered to raid; Qin and Fu beat them and captured more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Willow Valley Fan raided; Qin-Fu forces defeated them and seized over a thousand.

sentences.zh: 己亥，皇太后崩。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the empress dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，群臣三上表請聽政，不允。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the ministers thrice memorialized asking him to hear government; he did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the bureaucracy three times begged him to resume rule; he refused.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，李沆等詣宮門，見帝毀瘠過甚，退上五表求見，言西北軍事方殷，力請聽政，從之。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Li Hang and others went to the palace gate, saw the emperor wasted beyond measure, withdrew and submitted five memorials seeking audience; they spoke of pressing northwest military affairs and strongly urged him to hear government; he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Li Hang and colleagues, finding the emperor emaciated, filed five pleas citing northwest emergencies and at last won his return to audience.

sentences.zh: 麟府路言敗西人於神堆，破其砦柵。

translations.literal: The Qinfu circuit reported defeating western enemies at Shendui and storming their stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Qinfu reported a victory at Shendui and the capture of enemy forts.

sentences.zh: 己酉，帝始於崇政殿西廡衰服慟哭見群臣。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the emperor for the first time in mourning garb in the west corridor of Chongzheng Hall wailed and received the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, he first received ministers in mourning dress, weeping in Chongzheng’s west wing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，上大行皇太后諡曰明德。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiayin: the late empress dowager was given the posthumous title Bright Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiayin: the late dowager was styled Bright Virtue.

sentences.zh: 群臣三請御正殿，從之。

translations.literal: The ministers thrice asked him to hold court in the main hall; he assented.
translations.idiomatic: Three times the court begged him into the main hall; he agreed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，邢州地震不止。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Xing prefecture’s earthquakes did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Xingzhou’s tremors continued without pause.

sentences.zh: 以溪蠻寧息，民多復業，蠲澧州石門縣租二年。

translations.literal: Because the creek Miao had quieted and the people were returning to their fields, two years of land tax in Shimen county, Li prefecture, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: With creek rebels pacified and farmers returning, Li’s Shimen county received a two-year tax holiday.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以隆暑，休北邊役兵。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: because of oppressive heat, corvée troops on the northern frontier were stood down.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, northern labor drafts were halted in the summer heat.

sentences.zh: 瀛州地震。

translations.literal: Ying prefecture was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzhou quaked.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，邢州地連震不止，賜民租之半。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiashen: Xing prefecture’s land shook continuously without cease; half the people’s land tax was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiashen: endless quakes at Xingzhou won the people a half remission of land tax.

sentences.zh: 蒲端國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Pu’anduan sent envoys to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Pu’anduan sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔：諸路轉運使代還日，在任興除利害、升黜能否，凡所經畫事，悉條上以聞。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: when transport commissioners on all circuits completed their tours and returned, every measure of benefit or harm, every promotion or demotion of competence they had carried out—all their planning—was to be listed and reported.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, returning transport commissioners were ordered to file full reports on every reform, promotion, and demotion they had made.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，幸北宅視德欽疾。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiwei: the emperor visited the Northern Residence to see Deqin’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiwei: he visited the sick Deqin at the Northern Residence.

sentences.zh: 洪德砦言繼遷部將都尾等率屬歸附。

translations.literal: Hongde Fort reported that Jiqian’s officer Duwei and others had led their bands to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Hongde Fort reported Duwei and other Jiqian officers had defected.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔罷川峽、閩、廣州軍貢承天節，自今三千里外者罷之。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict: tribute missions for the Ascension Day festival from Sichuan gorges, Min, and Guang circuits were abolished; from now on those beyond three thousand li were ended.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Ascension Day tribute from the southwest and far south beyond three thousand li was canceled.

sentences.zh: 鎮戎軍言敗戎人于石門川。

translations.literal: Zhenrong army reported defeating Rong people at Shimen Creek.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenrong army reported a victory over Rong tribes at Shimen Creek.

sentences.zh: 庚午，德欽卒。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Deqin died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Deqin died.

sentences.zh: 洪德砦言蕃部羅泥天王本族諸首領各率屬歸附。

translations.literal: Hongde Fort reported that chieftains of the Fan King Luoni’s own clan each led their bands to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Hongde Fort reported chiefs of Fan King Luoni’s lineage had brought their people in.

sentences.zh: 趙保忠卒。

translations.literal: Zhao Baozhong died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Baozhong died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，暑甚，罷京城工役，遣使賜暍者藥。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the heat was extreme; capital labor projects were halted, and envoys were sent to bestow medicine on those stricken by sunstroke.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, in fierce heat capital works stopped and envoys distributed drugs to sunstroke victims.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，班用兵誅賞格。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiwei: the scale of rewards and punishments for troops in use was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guiwei: wartime reward-and-punishment regulations were issued.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，李沆薨。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Li Hang died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Li Hang died.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以翰林侍讀學士畢士安為吏部侍郎、參知政事。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Hanlin academician reader Bi Shi’an was made vice minister of personnel and participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, reader Bi Shi’an became vice minister of personnel and councilor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，益都民李仁美、國凝母皆百餘歲，詔賜粟帛。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: in Yidu, commoners Li Renmei and Guo Ning’s mother were each over a hundred; an edict bestowed grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Yidu’s centenarians Li Renmei and Guo Ning’s mother received grain and silk.

sentences.zh: 八月，涇原部署言擊萬子軍主族帳，斬首二百餘級。

translations.literal: Eighth month: the Jingyuan commissioner reported attacking the Wanzi army chief’s clan tents and taking more than two hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Jingyuan reported a raid on the Wanzi chieftain’s tents with over two hundred heads taken.

sentences.zh: 己未，以畢士安、寇準並平章事，宣徽南院使王繼英為樞密使，同知樞密院事馮拯、陳堯叟並簽署樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Bi Shi’an and Kou Zhun were both made grand councilors; Wang Jiying, commissioner of the southern bureau of the military affairs court, became military affairs commissioner; Feng Zheng and Chen Yaosou were both made co-signers of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Bi Shi’an and Kou Zhun became grand councilors; Wang Jiying took the southern bureau of military affairs; Feng Zheng and Chen Yaosou co-signed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔常參官二人共舉州縣官可任幕職者一人。

translations.literal: Day renshen, edict: two regular attendees were jointly to recommend one county or prefecture official fit for staff appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, each pair of regular court officials was to nominate one county officer fit for secretariat work.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以保平軍節度石保吉為武寧軍節度、同平章事。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Shi Baoji, military commissioner of Baoping, was made military commissioner of Wuning and co-grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Baoping’s Shi Baoji received Wuning command and a council seat.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遣使廣南東、西路疏決繫囚，犒勞軍校父老，訪民間便宜。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: envoys were sent to the eastern and western Guangnan circuits to review prisoners, comfort army officers and elders, and inquire into popular grievances.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, envoys went to east and west Guangnan to hear cases, reward garrisons and elders, and seek local remedies.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，罷北面齎御劍內臣，以劍屬主將。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiwei: the northern eunuch bearing the imperial sword was abolished; the sword was entrusted to the commanding general.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guiwei: the northern sword-bearing eunuch was abolished and the blade given to field commanders.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，令諸路轉運使考察官吏能否。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: transport commissioners on all circuits were ordered to examine officials’ competence.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, every transport commissioner was ordered to rate local officials.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔翰林學士承旨宋白等舉文武官可任藩郡者各一人。

translations.literal: Day jichou, edict: Hanlin academician reader Song Bai and others were to recommend one civil or military official each fit for a frontier prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Song Bai and fellow Hanlin readers were each to nominate one official fit for a border prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，召宰相議親征。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the emperor summoned the grand councilors to discuss a personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, he convened the cabinet to debate taking the field himself.

sentences.zh: 契丹耶律吳欲來降。

translations.literal: Yelü Wuyu of the Khitan came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan Yelü Wuyu defected.

sentences.zh: 宋州汴水決。

translations.literal: The Bian River burst its banks at Song prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Songzhou’s stretch of the Bian River broke.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，置祁州。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Qi prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Qi prefecture was founded.

sentences.zh: 河決澶州，遣使具舟濟民，給以糧餉。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Cang prefecture; envoys were sent with boats to ferry the people and grain was given them.
translations.idiomatic: Floods at Cangzhou brought boats and rations to stranded families.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙卯，詔河北吏民殺契丹者，所至援之，仍頒賞格。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yimao, edict: wherever people of Hebei killed Khitan, they were to be aided on the spot and reward scales were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, yimao: Hebei folk who killed Khitan were promised on-the-spot aid and published bounties.

sentences.zh: 壬申，江南旱，遣使決獄，訪民疾苦，祠境內山川。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Jiangnan suffered drought; envoys were sent to decide cases, inquire into the people’s hardships, and sacrifice to mountains and rivers within the circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, drought in Jiangnan sent judges abroad to hear suits, survey misery, and offer river-and-mountain rites.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，明德皇太后殯沙臺。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the Bright Virtue empress dowager’s coffin lay in state at Shatai.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Bright Virtue’s coffin rested at Shatai.

sentences.zh: 北平砦、威虜軍合兵大破契丹。

translations.literal: Beiping Fort and Weilu army joined forces and inflicted a great defeat on the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Beiping Fort and Weilu army together shattered a Khitan host.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，參知政事王欽若判天雄軍府兼都部署。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Participating Administrator Wang Qinruo was made prefect of Tianxiong and frontier commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Wang Qinruo became Tianxiong prefect and frontier commander.

sentences.zh: 契丹統軍撻覽率眾攻威虜、順安軍，三路都部署擊敗之，斬偏將，獲其輜重。

translations.literal: The Khitan commander-in-chief Tayan led troops to attack Weilu and Shun’an armies; the three-circuit frontier commissioner defeated them, beheaded a lieutenant general, and seized their baggage train.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan commander Tayan struck Weilu and Shun’an; the three-circuit commander routed him, killed a lieutenant, and took the train.

sentences.zh: 又攻北平砦及保州，復為州、砦兵所敗。

translations.literal: He again attacked Beiping Fort and Baozhou and was again defeated by prefectural and fort troops.
translations.idiomatic: He struck Beiping and Baozhou again and was beaten again by local garrisons.

sentences.zh: 撻覽與契丹主及其母并眾攻定州，宋兵拒于唐河，擊其遊騎。

translations.literal: Tayan, with the Khitan ruler and his mother and the whole host, attacked Ding prefecture; Song troops barred them at the Tang River and struck their scouting horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Tayan, the Khitan emperor, his mother, and the main army besieged Dingzhou; Song forces held the Tang River line and harried their scouts.

sentences.zh: 契丹駐陽城淀，因王繼忠致書于莫州石普以講和。

translations.literal: The Khitan encamped at Yangcheng Marsh; through Wang Jizhong they sent a letter to Shi Pu of Mozhou seeking peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan camped at Yangcheng Marsh and, via Wang Jizhong, wrote Mozhou’s Shi Pu to open talks.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以天雄軍都部署周瑩為駕前貝冀路都部署，侍衛馬軍都指揮使葛霸為駕前邢洺路都部署。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Zhou Ying, frontier commissioner of Tianxiong, was made commander before the imperial carriage on the Bei-Ji route; Ge Ba, commander of the palace horse guards, was made commander on the Xing-Mo route.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Tianxiong’s Zhou Ying took the Bei-Ji vanguard; palace cavalry chief Ge Ba took Xing-Mo.

sentences.zh: 己卯，高繼勳率兵擊敗契丹數萬騎於岢嵐軍。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Gao Jixun led troops and at Kelan army defeated tens of thousands of Khitan horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Gao Jixun at Kelan army destroyed a Khitan force of tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，詔修葺歷代聖賢陵墓。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renwu, edict: tombs of sages through the ages were to be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renwu: ancient sages’ tombs were ordered restored.

sentences.zh: 癸未，麟府路率部兵入朔州，破大狼水砦。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the Qinfu circuit led tribal troops into Shuozhou and stormed the Dalangshui fort.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Qinfu allies entered Shuozhou and took Dalangshui fort.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，令漕運所經州軍長吏兼輦運事。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: prefects on the grain transport route were ordered concurrently to oversee cartage.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, grain-route prefects were made responsible for transport as well.

sentences.zh: 戊子，祔明德皇后于太廟。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the Bright Virtue empress was enshrined in the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Bright Virtue joined the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命張齊賢兼青、淄、濰安撫使，丁謂兼鄆、齊、濮安撫使。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Zhang Qixian was ordered concurrently pacification commissioner of Qing, Zi, and Wei; Ding Wei concurrently of Yan, Qi, and Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhang Qixian took Qing-Zi-Wei pacification; Ding Wei took Yan-Qi-Pu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，幸故鄭國長公主第。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the emperor visited the late Princess of Zheng’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, he called at the late Princess of Zheng’s house.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔王超等率兵赴行在。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict: Wang Chao and others were to lead troops to the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Wang Chao and others were ordered to the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔魏能、張凝、田敏屯定州。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: Wei Neng, Zhang Ning, and Tian Min were to garrison Ding prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Wei Neng, Zhang Ning, and Tian Min were posted to Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以廝鐸督為朔方軍節度、靈州西面巡檢、西涼府六谷大首領。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Sidelu Du was made military commissioner of Shuofang, western Lingzhou inspector, and great chief of Xiliang’s Liugu.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Sidelu Du received Shuofang, western Lingzhou inspection, and chiefship over Xiliang’s Liugu.

sentences.zh: 保、莫州、威虜、岢嵐軍及北平砦皆擊敗契丹。

translations.literal: Ba, Mo prefectures, Weilu and Kelan armies, and Beiping Fort all defeated the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Ba, Mo, Weilu, Kelan, and Beiping each reported Khitan defeats.

sentences.zh: 既而王繼忠上言契丹請和，命閤門祗候曹利用往答之。

translations.literal: Then Wang Jizhong memorialized that the Khitan sought peace; the palace gate attendant Cao Liyong was ordered to go reply.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jizhong then reported Khitan peace feelers; Cao Liyong was sent to answer.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以雍王元份為東京留守。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Prince of Yong Yuanfen was made eastern capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Prince of Yong Yuanfen became eastern capital regent.

sentences.zh: 己酉，置龍圖閣待制。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the awaiting appointment of Dragon Diagram Pavilion was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Dragon Diagram Pavilion awaiting appointment was instituted.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinhai: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinhai: Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣使撫河北。

translations.literal: Day yimao: envoys were sent to comfort Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, envoys went to console Hebei.

sentences.zh: 契丹攻瀛州，知州李延渥率兵敗之，殺傷十餘萬眾，遁去。

translations.literal: The Khitan attacked Ying prefecture; prefect Li Yanwo led troops and defeated them; more than a hundred thousand were killed and wounded; they fled.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan forces hit Yingzhou; Li Yanwo broke them, killing and wounding over a hundred thousand before they fled.

sentences.zh: 官吏進秩、賜物有差。

translations.literal: Officials were advanced in rank and gifts bestowed according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and clerks were promoted and rewarded by degree.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣使安撫河東諸州。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: envoys were sent to pacify prefectures of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, envoys pacified Hedong prefectures.

sentences.zh: 契丹逼冀州，知州王嶼擊走之。

translations.literal: The Khitan pressed Ji prefecture; prefect Wang Yu drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan columns threatened Jizhou; Wang Yu repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，校獵近郊。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: a hunt was held near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the court hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣使安集河北流民。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: envoys were sent to settle Hebei refugees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, envoys resettled Hebei refugees.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以山南東道節度、同平章事李繼隆為駕前東面排陣使，武寧軍節度、同平章事石保吉為駕前西面排陣使。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Li Jilong, military commissioner of Shannan East and co-grand councilor, was made eastern battle-array commissioner before the carriage; Shi Baoji, military commissioner of Wuning and co-grand councilor, was made western battle-array commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Li Jilong became eastern battle commissioner and Shi Baoji western commissioner before the imperial march.

sentences.zh: 石州地震。

translations.literal: Shi prefecture was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhou quaked.

sentences.zh: 庚午，車駕北巡。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the imperial carriage toured north.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the emperor marched north.

sentences.zh: 司天言：日抱珥，黃氣充塞，宜不戰而却。

translations.literal: The director of astronomy said: the sun was ringed, yellow vapor filled the sky—it was fitting not to fight but to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomers reported solar halos and yellow mists filling the sky—a sign to avoid battle and pull back.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，駐蹕韋城縣。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the carriage halted at Wei city county.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the court encamped at Wei city.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，寒甚，左右進貂帽毳裘，却之曰：「臣下皆苦寒，朕安用此？

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the cold was extreme; attendants offered sable caps and fur robes; he refused them, saying: "My ministers all suffer bitter cold—how can I use these?
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, in bitter cold attendants offered furs; he refused: "My officers freeze—what right have I to fur?"

sentences.zh: 」王繼忠數馳奏請和，帝謂宰相曰：「繼忠言契丹請和，雖許之，然河冰已合，且其情多詐，不可不為之備。

translations.literal: " Wang Jizhong repeatedly sent urgent reports begging peace; the emperor told the grand councilors: "Jizhong says the Khitan seek peace; though we agree, the river ice has already formed, and their intent is mostly deceit—we cannot fail to prepare."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jizhong’s repeated peace appeals drew the emperor’s warning to his ministers: even if peace were real, frozen rivers and Khitan treachery demanded full readiness.

sentences.zh: 」契丹兵至澶州北，直犯前軍西陣，其大帥撻覽耀兵出陣，俄中伏弩死。

translations.literal: Khitan troops reached north of Cang prefecture and struck straight at the western wing of the forward army; their great commander Tayan displayed his troops out of formation and soon was killed by a hidden crossbow.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan forces reached north Cangzhou and hit the vanguard’s west wing; Tayan rode out to display his array and fell to a hidden crossbow.

sentences.zh: 丙子，帝次澶州，渡河，幸北砦，御城北樓，召諸將撫慰。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the emperor halted at Cang prefecture, crossed the river, visited the northern fort, mounted the city’s north tower, and summoned the generals to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, he reached Cangzhou, crossed the river, entered the north fort, stood on the north wall, and addressed his generals.

sentences.zh: 鄆州得契丹諜者，斬之。

translations.literal: Yan prefecture obtained a Khitan spy and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou captured a Khitan spy and executed him.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，曹利用使契丹還。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Cao Liyong returned from his mission to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Cao Liyong returned from the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengchen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, new moon gengchen: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 契丹使韓杞來講和。

translations.literal: Khitan envoys led by Han Qi came to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan envoys under Han Qi arrived to treat for peace.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，遣使安撫河北、京東。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: envoys were sent to comfort Hebei and Jingdong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, envoys were sent to Hebei and Jingdong.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸城南臨河亭，賜鑿凌軍綿襦。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the emperor visited the riverside pavilion south of the city and bestowed padded coats on the ice-breaking troops.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, he visited the south riverside pavilion and gave quilted coats to the ice-breakers.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸北砦，又幸李繼隆營，命從官將校飲，犒賜諸軍有差。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: he visited the northern fort, then Li Jilong’s camp, ordered attendant officials and officers to drink, and rewarded the armies in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, he inspected the north fort and Li Jilong’s camp, feasted officers, and distributed rewards.

sentences.zh: 詔諭兩京以將班師。

translations.literal: An edict announced to the two capitals that the armies would soon withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Both capitals were told the armies would soon march home.

sentences.zh: 甲申，契丹使姚東之來獻御衣食物。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Khitan envoy Yao Dongzhi came presenting imperial robes and food.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Khitan envoy Yao Dongzhi brought robes and provisions.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，御行營南樓觀河，遂宴從官及契丹使。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: from the southern tower of the marching camp he viewed the river, then feasted attendant officials and the Khitan envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, from the camp’s south tower he watched the river and banqueted courtiers and Khitan envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣使撫諭懷、孟、澤、潞、鄭、滑等州，放強壯歸農。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: envoys were sent to comfort Huai, Meng, Ze, Lu, Zheng, and Hua prefectures and to release strong men to farming.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Huai through Hua received envoys and strong men were sent back to the fields.

sentences.zh: 遣監西京左藏庫李繼昌使契丹定和，戒諸將勿出兵邀其歸路。

translations.literal: Supervisor of the western capital left treasury Li Jichang was sent to the Khitan to fix the peace; the generals were admonished not to ambush their homeward route.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jichang went to the Khitan to seal peace; generals were warned not to cut off their retreat.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，遣使安集河北流民，瘞暴骸。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: envoys were sent to settle Hebei refugees and bury exposed corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Hebei refugees were resettled and the dead buried.

sentences.zh: 以閤門祗候曹利用為東上閤門使、忠州刺史。

translations.literal: Palace gate attendant Cao Liyong was made eastern upper gate commissioner and prefect of Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Liyong became eastern upper gate commissioner and Zhong prefect.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸北砦勞軍，召李繼隆、石保吉宴射行宮西亭。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the emperor visited the northern fort to comfort the army, summoned Li Jilong and Shi Baoji to feast and shoot at the west pavilion of the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, he reviewed the north fort, then feasted and shot with Li Jilong and Shi Baoji at the camp’s west pavilion.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，赦河北諸州死罪以下，民經蹂踐者給復二年，死事官吏追錄子孫。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Hebei prefectures below capital crime were pardoned; people trampled by war received two years’ tax relief; officers killed in service had their descendants enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Hebei won amnesty below capital crime, two years’ relief for war-ravaged households, and registers for fallen officers’ heirs.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，雍王元份疾，命參知政事王旦權東京留守。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Prince of Yong Yuanfen fell ill; Participating Administrator Wang Dan was ordered acting eastern capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Yuanfen sickened and Wang Dan acted as eastern capital regent.

sentences.zh: 甲午，車駕發澶州，大寒，賜道傍貧民襦袴。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the imperial carriage departed Cang prefecture; the cold was extreme; padded coats and trousers were bestowed on poor people along the road.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, leaving Cangzhou in fierce cold, he gave quilted clothes to roadside paupers.

sentences.zh: 乙未，契丹使丁振以誓書來。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Khitan envoy Ding Zhen brought the oath document.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Ding Zhen delivered the Khitan oath.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，契丹兵出塞。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Khitan troops left the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Khitan armies withdrew beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，至自澶州。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the emperor returned from Cang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, he returned from Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸雍王元份宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the emperor visited Prince of Yong Yuanfen’s palace to see his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, he visited the sick Yuanfen.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，錄契丹誓書頒河北、河東諸州。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the Khitan oath was copied and promulgated in Hebei and Hedong prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Khitan oath was copied to every Hebei and Hedong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣使撫問河北東、西路官吏將卒，訪察功狀。

translations.literal: Day guimao: envoys were sent to inquire after officials, soldiers, and officers of Hebei east and west circuits and to investigate merit.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, envoys toured Hebei circuits to salute the ranks and record deeds.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，改威虜諸軍名。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the names of Weilu and related armies were changed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Weilu and sister armies were renamed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔恤河北傷殘。

translations.literal: Day wushen, edict: the wounded and maimed of Hebei were to be relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Hebei’s wounded received relief orders.

sentences.zh: 是歲，交州、西涼府、西、高、豐、甘、沙州、占城、大食、蒲端、龜茲國來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Jiaozhou, Xiliang prefecture, Xi, Gao, Feng, Gan, Shazhou, Champa, Dashi, Pu’anduan, and Kucha came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute came from Jiaozhou, Xiliang, Xi, Gao, Feng, Gan, Shazhou, Champa, the Arabs, Pu’anduan, and Kucha.

sentences.zh: 江南東、西路饑，陝、濱、棣州蝗害稼，命使振之。

translations.literal: Jiangnan east and west circuits suffered famine; Shan, Bin, and Di prefectures locusts harmed the crops; envoys were ordered to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck Jiangnan; locusts ruined crops in Shan, Bin, and Di—relief envoys were dispatched.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚戌朔，以契丹講和，大赦天下，非故鬬殺、放火、強盜、偽造符印、犯贓官典、十惡至死者，悉除之。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day gengxu new moon: because of Khitan peace, great amnesty for the empire—except for brawling homicide, arson, robbery, forging seals, corrupt officials, and the ten abominations down to death, all were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, new moon gengxu: peace with the Khitan brought empire-wide amnesty, sparing all but capital crimes and the ten great offenses.

sentences.zh: 壬子，放河北諸州強壯歸農，令有司市耕牛給之。

translations.literal: Day renzi: strong men of Hebei prefectures were released to farming; officials were ordered to buy plow oxen and give them.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Hebei laborers returned to the plow and officials bought oxen for them.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，罷諸路行營，合鎮、定兩路都部署為一。

translations.literal: Day guichou: marching camps on all circuits were abolished; the Zhen and Ding frontier commissioners were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, field headquarters were dissolved and Zhen-Ding commands united.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，罷北面部署、鈐轄、都監、使臣二百九十餘員。

translations.literal: Day yimao: more than two hundred ninety posts of northern commissioner, controller, inspector, and envoy were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, over two hundred ninety northern staff posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 振河北饑。

translations.literal: Hebei famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei famine relief was ordered.

sentences.zh: 遣監察御史朱摶赴德清軍收瘞戰沒遺骸，致祭。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Zhu Tuan was sent to Deqing army to collect and bury the remains of the battle dead and perform sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhu Tuan went to Deqing to gather battle dead, bury them, and offer rites.

sentences.zh: 罷江、淮、荊、浙增榷酤錢。

translations.literal: The added liquor monopoly levies on Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Extra liquor taxes on Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe were lifted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，幸雍王元份宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the emperor visited Prince of Yong Yuanfen’s palace to see his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, he again visited the sick Yuanfen.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔淮南以上供軍儲振饑民。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict: Huainan and above were to use commissary grain to feed famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, south Huainan circuits were to feed the hungry from army stores.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以天平軍節度使王超為崇信軍節度。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Wang Chao, military commissioner of Tianping, was made military commissioner of Chongxin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Tianping’s Wang Chao received Chongxin command.

sentences.zh: 省河北戍兵十之五，緣邊三之一。

translations.literal: Hebei garrison troops were reduced by five-tenths; frontier troops by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei garrisons were cut by half; frontier troops by a third.

sentences.zh: 所在量軍儲饋給，勿調民飛輓。

translations.literal: Wherever located, army stores were measured and issued—do not levy the people for forced transport.
translations.idiomatic: Local granaries were to supply troops without pressing civilians for convoy labor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，幸李繼隆第視疾。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the emperor visited Li Jilong’s residence to see his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, he called on the sick Li Jilong.

sentences.zh: 京西民轉送軍儲者賜租十二。

translations.literal: People of Jingxi who transported army grain were given a twelve-part rent remission.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxi grain porters received a twelve-part tax cut.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔河北轉運使察官屬不任職者以名聞。

translations.literal: Day dingchou, edict: Hebei transport commissioners were to report unfit subordinates by name.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Hebei transport chiefs were to name incompetent staff.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，取淮、楚間踏犁式頒之河朔。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the tread-plow pattern of Huai and Chu was taken and promulgated in Hebei north.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Huai-Chu tread-plows were issued to the Hebei north.

sentences.zh: 二月，嘉、邛州鑄大鐵錢。

translations.literal: Second month: Jia and Qiong prefectures cast great iron coins.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Jia and Qiong began casting large iron cash.

sentences.zh: 置霸州、安肅軍榷場。

translations.literal: Border markets were established at Bazhou and Ansù army.
translations.idiomatic: Bazhou and Ansù army opened frontier markets.

sentences.zh: 癸未，李繼隆卒。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Li Jilong died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Li Jilong died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，定入粟實邊授官等級。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: grades of office for delivering grain to the frontier were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, ranks for frontier grain donors were codified.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣使安撫交州。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: envoys were sent to pacify Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, envoys pacified Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔緣邊得契丹馬牛，悉縱還之；

translations.literal: Day jiawu, edict: on the frontier, Khitan horses and cattle obtained were all to be released back;
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, frontier Khitan livestock captured were to be returned;

sentences.zh: 沒蕃漢口歸業者，給資糧。

translations.literal: Han people who had been taken by the Fan and returned to their occupations were given supplies and grain.
translations.idiomatic: repatriated Chinese received rations and seed.

sentences.zh: 弛邊民鐵禁。

translations.literal: The iron ban on frontier people was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier iron restrictions were eased.

sentences.zh: 環州言戎人入寇，擊走之，俘其軍主。

translations.literal: Huan prefecture reported Rong people entered to raid; they were driven off and their army chief was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Huanzhou reported a Rong raid repulsed and its commander taken.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣太子中允孫僅等使契丹。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Palace Attendant Sun Jin and others were dispatched as envoys to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Sun Jin and fellow palace attendants went to the Khitan as envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁未，呂蒙正對便殿。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Lü Mengzheng addressed the throne in the Convenience Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Lü Mengzheng faced the emperor in the Convenience Hall.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，御試禮部貢舉人。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiayin: the emperor held the palace examination of Ministry of Rites tributary graduates.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiayin: the court examined Ministry of Rites graduates in the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，鄭州防禦使魏能坐歸師不整，責授右羽林將軍。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Zhengzhou defense commissioner Wei Neng, for returning troops in disorder, was demoted to Right Yulin general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Wei Neng of Zhengzhou lost his defense post for a ragged withdrawal and became Right Yulin general.

sentences.zh: 庚申，禁邊民入外境掠奪。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: border people were forbidden to enter foreign territory to plunder.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, frontier folk were barred from raiding across the border.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，賜進士李迪等瓊林宴。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: the Jinshi Li Di and others were granted the Qionlin banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Li Di and the new jinshi were feasted at Qionlin.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，樞密直學士劉師道責授忠武軍行軍司馬，右正言、知制誥陳堯咨單州團練使，俱坐考試不公。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Privy Council academician Liu Shidao was demoted to Zhongwu army march commander; Right Rectifier and drafting drafter Chen Yaozi was made Danzhou military training commissioner—both for unfair examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Liu Shidao and Chen Yaozi were punished for rigging exams—Liu sent to Zhongwu as march commander, Chen to Danzhou as training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，葺河北城池。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Hebei fortresses and cities were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Hebei walls and towns were put in order.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，置資政殿學士，以王欽若為之。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Zizhi Hall academicians were established; Wang Qinruo was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Zizhi Hall academicianate was created with Wang Qinruo in post.

sentences.zh: 馮拯為參知政事。

translations.literal: Feng Zheng was made Participating Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zheng joined the council as Participating Administrator.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以寧國軍留後、駙馬都尉吳元扆為武勝軍節度。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Ningguo army military prefect and imperial son-in-law commandant Wu Yuanyi was made military commissioner of Wusheng army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Wu Yuanyi—Ningguo regent and imperial son-in-law—took Wusheng army.

sentences.zh: 戎人寇環州，擊敗之，執其酋慶者多，請戮之，詔釋其罪，配淮南。

translations.literal: Rong people raided Huan prefecture and were defeated; their chief Qingduo was captured; execution was requested; an edict released his crime and assigned him to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: Rong raiders struck Huanzhou and were beaten; chief Qingduo was taken. Though some urged execution, the throne spared him and sent him to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，幸國子監。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wushen: the emperor visited the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wushen: the court visited the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，司天少監史序上乾元寶典。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Vice Director of Astronomy Shi Xu presented the Qiankun Treasure Canon.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Shi Xu, vice director of astronomy, submitted the Qiankun Treasure Canon.

sentences.zh: 己未，幸元份宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the emperor visited Prince Yuanfen’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, he called at Yuanfen’s palace to see him through his illness.

sentences.zh: 庚申，御試河北舉人。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the palace examination of Hebei candidates was held.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Hebei graduates were examined at court.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宴近臣于資政殿。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: near officials were banqueted at Zizhi Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, intimate ministers were feasted in Zizhi Hall.

sentences.zh: 餞种放遊嵩山。

translations.literal: A farewell feast was held for Zhong Fang’s journey to Mount Song.
translations.idiomatic: The court saw Zhong Fang off on his travels to Mount Song.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔天下榷利勿增羨為額。

translations.literal: Day guiyou, edict: throughout the realm, monopoly profits were not to add surplus as quota.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou: state monopolies were forbidden to pad their targets with extra levies.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，詔勸學。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingchou, edict: learning was to be encouraged.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingchou: an edict urged the realm to study.

sentences.zh: 幸諸王宮。

translations.literal: The emperor visited the princes’ palaces.
translations.idiomatic: He toured the princes’ residences.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命法直官用士人。

translations.literal: Day jimao: legal review officials were ordered to be drawn from literati.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, law-review posts were opened to scholar-officials.

sentences.zh: 己丑，曹州民趙諫、趙諤以恐喝贓鉅萬伏誅。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Cao prefecture commoners Zhao Jian and Zhao E, for extortion taking bribes of tens of thousands, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Zhao Jian and Zhao E of Caozhou were executed for extorting tens of thousands in bribes.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以趙德明歸款，諭河西諸蕃各守疆界。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: because Zhao Deming had submitted, the Hexi tribes were instructed each to guard their borders.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, with Zhao Deming’s submission, Hexi tribes were told to keep within their bounds.

sentences.zh: 高瓊求板本經史，詔給之。

translations.literal: Gao Qiong requested block-printed classics and histories; an edict granted them.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qiong asked for printed classics and histories and received them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，劉質進兵要論，召試中書。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengxu: Liu Zhi presented Essentials of Military Operations and was summoned to test at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengxu: Liu Zhi’s Essentials of Military Operations won him a Secretariat examination.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔復賢良方正能直言極諫等六科。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict: the six categories including Worthy and Upright Able to Speak Bluntly and Remonstrate Extremally were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, six special recruitment tracks—including “worthy and upright, able to remonstrate bluntly”—were revived.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，雍王元份薨。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuyin: Prince of Yong Yuanfen died.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuyin: Prince of Yong Yuanfen died.

sentences.zh: 丙戊，有司上新定權衡法。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the relevant office presented the newly revised weights-and-measures law.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the authorities submitted the revised standard weights law.

sentences.zh: 遣內臣奉安太祖聖容于揚州建隆寺。

translations.literal: Inner officials were sent to install Taizu’s sacred image at Jianlong Temple in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Palace envoys installed Taizu’s portrait at Yangzhou’s Jianlong Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，翰林學士晁迥先為鄆王元份留守官屬，坐輔導無狀，責授右司郎中。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Hanlin academician Chao Jiong, having earlier been on Prince of Yan Yuanfen’s regency staff, for deficient guidance was demoted to Right Bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Chao Jiong—once on Yuanfen’s Yanzhou staff—was demoted to Right Bureau director for poor tutelage.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，幸南宮及恭孝太子宮。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the emperor visited the Southern Palace and the Palace of Filial Respect for the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, he visited the Southern Palace and the crown prince’s filial palace.

sentences.zh: 有星孛于紫微。

translations.literal: A comet appeared in Ziwei.
translations.idiomatic: A broom star blazed in the Purple Forbidden enclosure.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，以向敏中為鄜延路都部署。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingwei: Xiang Minzhong was made commander-in-chief of Fuyan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingwei: Xiang Minzhong took overall command on the Fuyan front.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，淮南旱，詔轉運使疏理繫囚。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Huainan suffered drought; edict ordered transport commissioners to review imprisoned persons.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, drought in Huainan sent transport commissioners to review jail cases.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，三司上新編敕。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the Three Departments presented the newly compiled statutes.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Three Departments submitted the new statute compilation.

sentences.zh: 群臣三表上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: The hundred officials thrice submitted tables for an honorific title; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Three times the bureaucracy offered an honorific title; thrice the throne refused.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸興國寺傳法院觀新譯經。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the emperor visited Xingguo Temple’s Dharma Transmission Court to view newly translated scriptures.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, he went to Xingguo Temple’s lecture hall to see fresh translations.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命近臣慮開封府繫囚。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: near officials were ordered to review Kaifeng prefecture’s prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, intimate ministers were told to examine Kaifeng jail cases.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔：荊湖溪峒民為蠻人所掠而歸者，勿限年月，給還舊產。

translations.literal: Day renshen, edict: Jing-Hu creek-district people who returned after being plundered by Miao were not to be limited by years; old property was to be restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen: Jing-Hu gorge folk reclaimed from Miao raids could recover old holdings without a time limit.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，丁謂上景德農田編敕。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengchen: Ding Wei presented the Jingde agricultural statutes compilation.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengchen: Ding Wei submitted the Jingde farmland statute digest.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，畢士安薨。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Bi Shian died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Bi Shian died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣職方郎中韓國華等使契丹。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Palace Bureau director Han Guohua and others were sent as envoys to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Han Guohua of the Palace Bureau led an embassy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，詔翰林侍講學士邢昺等舉堪為學官者十人。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wushen, edict: Hanlin lecture academician Xing Bing and others were to recommend ten men fit to be academic officials.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wushen: Xing Bing and fellow Hanlin lecturers were each to name ten scholars fit for academic posts.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，享太廟。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the imperial ancestors were sacrificed to in the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the court offered to the imperial ancestors.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Circular Mound; a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Heaven and Earth were worshipped at the round altar and the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大宴含光殿。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: a great banquet at Hanguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, a grand feast was held at Hanguang Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，寇準加中書侍郎兼工部尚書，楚王元佐為右衛上將軍，彭城郡王元偓進封寧王，安定郡王元偁進封舒王，曹國公元儼進封廣陵郡王，安定郡公惟吉加同平章事。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Kou Zhun was made additional Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Works; Prince of Chu Yuanzuo was made Right Guard General-in-Chief; Prince of Pengcheng Yuan Shuai was advanced to Prince of Ning; Prince of Anding Yuan Huai was advanced to Prince of Shu; Prince of Cao Yuan Yan was advanced to Prince of Guangling; Duke of Anding Wei Ji was made co-Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Kou Zhun added Secretariat vice director and Works minister; Yuanzuo became Right Guard general-in-chief; Yuan Shuai rose to Prince of Ning, Yuan Huai to Prince of Shu, Yuan Yan to Prince of Guangling; Wei Ji joined the council as co–grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，契丹使來賀承天節。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Khitan envoys came to congratulate the Chengtian festival.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Khitan envoys arrived for the Chengtian birthday rites.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，置資政殿大學士，以王欽若為之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinsi: Grand Academician of Zizhi Hall was established; Wang Qinruo was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinsi: Wang Qinruo became the first Grand Academician of Zizhi Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以高瓊為忠武軍節度，葛霸為昭德軍節度。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Gao Qiong was made military commissioner of Zhongwu army; Ge Ba was made military commissioner of Zhaode army.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Gao Qiong took Zhongwu army and Ge Ba took Zhaode army.

sentences.zh: 對京畿父老於長春殿，賜帛有差。

translations.literal: The capital district elders were received at Changchun Hall; silk was bestowed in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Capital elders were summoned to Changchun Hall and given graded gifts of silk.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent envoys to congratulate the coming New Year’s day.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan envoys came to greet the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，夏州、西涼府、邛部川蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Xia prefecture, Xiliang prefecture, and Qiong-Bu-Chuan tribes came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xia, Xiliang, and Qiong-Bu-Chuan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 淮南、兩浙、荊湖北路饑，京東蝻生，閩颶風不害稼，遣使分振。

translations.literal: Huainan, Two Zhe, and northern Jing-Hu circuits suffered famine; Jingdong had locust larvae; Fujian hurricanes did not harm crops; envoys were sent to relieve separately.
translations.idiomatic: Famine hit Huainan, Two Zhe, and north Jing-Hu; locusts hatched in Jingdong; Fujian weather spared the grain—relief envoys went out by region.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁巳，親釋逋負繫囚。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, first month, day dingsi: the emperor personally released prisoners for unpaid debts.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3, first month, dingsi: the emperor freed debtors still in jail.

sentences.zh: 振畿縣貧民，收瘞遺骸。

translations.literal: Poor people of the capital districts were relieved; exposed corpses were gathered and buried.
translations.idiomatic: Capital paupers received aid and stray bones were collected for burial.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔緣邊歸業民給復三年。

translations.literal: Day dingmao, edict: border people returning to their occupations were given tax exemption for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, frontier families resuming farming won three years’ tax relief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，置常平倉。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Ever-Normal Granaries were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Ever-Normal Granaries were set up.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，幸北宅省德恭疾。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu: the emperor visited the North Residence to inquire after Degong’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiaxu: he went to the North Residence to see the ailing Degong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔京東西、淮南、河北振乏食客戶。

translations.literal: Day yihai, edict: Jingdong east and west, Huainan, and Hebei were to relieve needy guest households.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, east and west Jingdong, Huainan, and Hebei were ordered to aid indigent tenant families.

sentences.zh: 己卯，謁明德皇后攢宮，賜守奉人緡帛。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the Bright Virtue empress’s mortuary palace was visited; guardians were given cash and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, he paid respects at Bright Virtue’s mortuary hall and rewarded the caretakers.

sentences.zh: 甲申，禁民開近陵域地。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: people were forbidden to open land near imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, farming near imperial tombs was banned.

sentences.zh: 以宋州為應天府。

translations.literal: Song prefecture was made Yingtian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Songzhou was elevated to Yingtian prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，王繼英卒。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Wang Jiying died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wang Jiying died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以中書侍郎兼工部尚書、平章事寇準為刑部尚書，左丞、參知政事王旦為工部尚書、平章事。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Works and Grand Councilor Kou Zhun was made Minister of Punishments; Left Vice Director and Participating Administrator Wang Dan was made Minister of Works and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Kou Zhun moved from council and Works to Punishments; Wang Dan rose from vice director and participating administrator to Works minister and grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，王欽若、陳堯叟並知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Wang Qinruo and Chen Yaosou were both made supervisors of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Wang Qinruo and Chen Yaosou jointly took charge of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士趙安仁參知政事。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician Zhao Anren was made Participating Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Anren of the Hanlin Academy joined the council as Participating Administrator.

sentences.zh: 樞密都承旨韓崇訓、馬知節並簽署樞密院事。

translations.literal: Privy Council chief coordinator Han Chongxun and Ma Zhijie were both made cosigners of Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Han Chongxun and Ma Zhijie, Privy Council coordinators, were made cosigning controllers.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，客星出東南。

translations.literal: Third month, day yisi: a guest star appeared in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yisi: a guest star showed in the southeast sky.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免隨州光化民貸糧。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Suizhou Guanghua people’s borrowed grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Guanghua in Suizhou had its grain loans forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔儆諫臣悉心獻替。

translations.literal: Day jiwei, edict: remonstrance officials were admonished to devote themselves to presenting replacements.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, censors were urged to speak frankly and offer real remedies.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，幸秦國長公主第。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiyou: the emperor visited the Princess of Qin the Elder’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guiyou: he called on the elder Princess of Qin.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸開寶寺，遂幸御龍直班院，觀教閱弓刀。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: he visited Kaibao Temple, then the Imperial Dragon Direct Battalion yard, observing drill of bows and blades.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, he toured Kaibao Temple and the Imperial Dragon guard yard to watch bow and blade drill.

sentences.zh: 又幸左騏驥院，賜從官馬、群牧使等器幣。

translations.literal: Again he visited the Left Imperial Horse Stud; attendant officials, the herd commissioner, and others were given vessels and silks.
translations.idiomatic: He went on to the Left Horse Stud and rewarded attendants and the herd commissioner with gear and silk.

sentences.zh: 還幸崇文院觀圖籍，賜編修官金帛有差。

translations.literal: Returning, he visited Chongwen Court to view books; compilation officials were given gold and silk in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Back at Chongwen Court he browsed the collections and paid the editors graded gifts of gold and silk.

sentences.zh: 己卯，置清平、宣化二軍。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Qingping and Xuanhua two armies were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the Qingping and Xuanhua armies were founded.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，置河北緣邊安撫使、副、都監于雄州。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Hebei border pacification commissioner, deputy, and chief inspector were established at Xiong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xiongzhou became seat of a Hebei frontier pacification commissioner, deputy, and chief inspector.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命使巡撫益、利、梓、夔、福建諸路，決獄及犒設將吏、父老。

translations.literal: Day renchen: envoys were ordered to tour and comfort Yi, Li, Zi, Kui, and Fujian circuits, deciding cases and feasting generals, officers, and elders.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, touring envoys were sent through Yi, Li, Zi, Kui, and Fujian to judge suits and feast troops and elders.

sentences.zh: 乙未，种放賜告歸終南山。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Zhong Fang was granted leave to return to Zhongnan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Zhong Fang was given leave to retire to Zhongnan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣使巡撫江浙路。

translations.literal: Day jihai: envoys were sent to tour and comfort the Jiang-Zhe circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, envoys toured Jiang-Zhe to console the region.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，日當食不虧。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renyin: the sun should have been eclipsed but was not obscured.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renyin: a predicted eclipse never darkened the sun.

sentences.zh: 周伯星見。

translations.literal: The Zhoubo star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhoubo star was seen.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，置京東五路巡檢。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: five Jingdong circuit inspectors were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, five Jingdong route inspectors were appointed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸北宅視德恭疾。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the emperor visited the North Residence to see Degong’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, he again went to the North Residence to visit Degong.

sentences.zh: 己未，德恭卒。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Degong died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Degong died.

sentences.zh: 西涼府廝鐸督部落多疾，賜以藥物。

translations.literal: The tribes under Sidelu Du of Xiliang prefecture were mostly ill; medicines were granted them.
translations.idiomatic: Sidelu Du’s Xiliang tribes were racked by disease and received imperial medicines.

sentences.zh: 渭州妙娥族三千餘帳內附。

translations.literal: More than three thousand households of the Miao’e tribe in Weizhou submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Over three thousand Miao’e tents in Weizhou came in under the throne.

sentences.zh: 復置高州。

translations.literal: Gaozhou was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozhou was restored.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，群臣固請聽樂，從之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingzi: the hundred officials firmly requested music be heard; the emperor consented.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingzi: ministers pressed for court music and the emperor relented.

sentences.zh: 詔三班考較使臣以七年為限。

translations.literal: Edict: Three-Ranks examination of envoy-officials was fixed at seven years.
translations.idiomatic: An edict set seven years as the term for Three-Ranks review of envoy-officials.

sentences.zh: 知廣州凌策請發兵定交阯亂，帝以黎桓素修職貢，不欲伐喪，命遵前詔安撫。

translations.literal: Guangzhou prefect Ling Ce requested sending troops to settle Jiaozhi turmoil; the emperor, because Li Huan had always maintained tribute duties, did not wish to attack during mourning; he ordered following the previous edict to pacify.
translations.idiomatic: Ling Ce of Guangzhou wanted troops for Jiaozhi’s chaos, but Li Huan’s steady tribute made the emperor refuse a mourning-time invasion—old orders to pacify would stand.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷兩川稅課金二分。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the two Sichuan circuits’ two-tenths tax on gold was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the two Sichuan circuits’ twenty-percent gold levy was lifted.

sentences.zh: 乙未，汴水暴漲，賜役兵錢。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Bian River rose violently; corvée soldiers were given money.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, a Bian River flood brought cash to the laboring soldiers.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣使振應天府水災及瘞溺死者。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: envoys were sent to relieve Yingtian prefecture’s flood disaster and bury drowned dead.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, envoys aided Yingtian’s flood victims and buried the drowned.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，減鄜延戍兵。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renyin: Fuyan garrison troops were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renyin: the Fuyan garrison was cut.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔渭州、鎮戎軍收穫蕃部牛送給內地耕民。

translations.literal: Day gengxu, edict: Weizhou and Zhenrong army were to collect Fan tribes’ cattle and send them to interior farming people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu: Weizhou and Zhenrong were to round up tribal cattle for inland farmers.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜廣南聖惠方，歲給錢五萬，市藥療病者。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the Guangnan Sacred Beneficent Formula was granted; fifty thousand cash yearly to buy medicines for the sick.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Guangnan Sacred Beneficent Formula was issued with fifty thousand cash a year for charity medicine.

sentences.zh: 邵曄上邕州至交阯水陸路及控制宜州山川等圖，帝曰：「祖宗闢土廣大，唯當慎守，不必貪無用地，苦勞兵力。

translations.literal: Shao Ye presented maps of the Yongzhou–Jiaozhi land and water routes and of controlling Yizhou’s mountains and rivers; the emperor said: “Our ancestors opened vast territory; we need only guard carefully, not covet useless land and weary military strength—
translations.idiomatic: Shao Ye submitted route maps from Yongzhou to Jiaozhi and charts to dominate Yizhou’s terrain; the emperor replied: “The founders won a broad realm—hold it well; do not grasp barren ground and grind the army down—

sentences.zh: 」甲子，大宴含光殿，始用樂。

translations.literal: 」On jiazi day a great banquet was held at Hanguang Hall; music was used for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiazi he gave a great feast at Hanguang Hall—the first time the court employed music.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大風，遣中使視稼。

translations.literal: On bingyin day there was a great wind; palace envoys were sent to inspect the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin a gale rose; the emperor sent envoys to check the fields.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，閱太常新集雅樂。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: the emperor reviewed the Ministry of Rites’ newly compiled elegant music.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiaxu, he reviewed the Court of Rites’ new court music.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸寶相院。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: he visited Baoxiang Cloister.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he visited Baoxiang Cloister.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔川峽戍兵二年者代之。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: garrison troops in the Sichuan gorges who had served two years were relieved and replaced.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict rotated Sichuan gorge garrisons who had completed two years’ service.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，工部侍郎董儼坐躁競傾狡，責授山南東道行軍司馬。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Vice Minister of Works Dong Yan, convicted of rash rivalry and treacherous scheming, was demoted to campaigning army marshal of Shannan East.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Dong Yan of the Ministry of Works, guilty of reckless ambition and intrigue, was stripped to campaigning marshal in Shannan East.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，宴射含芳園。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiayin: banquet and archery at Hanfang Garden.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiayin: he feasted and shot arrows at Hanfang Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，御試賢良方正直言極諫科。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the emperor personally examined candidates for the Worthy and Upright, Straight-speaking and Extreme-remonstrance degree.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he held the imperial examination for Worthy and Upright remonstrators.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幸元偓宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day renxu: he visited Yuanwei Palace to inquire after an illness.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he called at Yuanwei Palace to see the sick.

sentences.zh: 甲子，置諸陵齋宮。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: fasting palaces were established at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi fasting lodges were set up at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，放西州納質人。

translations.literal: Day yichou: hostages from Xizhou were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Xizhou hostages were sent home.

sentences.zh: 夏州趙德明奉表歸款。

translations.literal: Zhao Deming of Xia prefecture submitted a memorial pledging allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Deming of Xiazhou submitted his allegiance in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，以趙德明為定難軍節度兼侍中，封西平王。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengwu: Zhao Deming was made military commissioner of Dingnan and concurrent Palace Attendant, enfeoffed as Prince of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, gengwu: Zhao Deming became Dingnan commissioner and Palace Attendant, enfeoffed Prince of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 甲午，兩浙轉運使姚鉉坐不法除名，為連州文學。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Liangzhe transport commissioner Yao Xuan, convicted of illegal conduct, was removed from office and made literary officer at Lianzhou.
