translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Yao Xuan, Liangzhe transport commissioner, was cashiered for misconduct and posted as Lianzhou literary officer.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，葬明德皇后。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Bright Virtue empress was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Bright Virtue empress was interred.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，周伯星再見。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renyin: the Zhoubo comet appeared again.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renyin: the Zhoubo comet returned.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiyou: Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，高瓊卒。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Gao Qiong died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Gao Qiong died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，狩近郊，以親獲兔付有司薦廟。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: he hunted near the suburbs, personally caught a rabbit, and handed it to the officials for temple offering.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he hunted the near suburbs, took a rabbit himself, and sent it to the ministries for the temple rite.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔牛羊司畜有孳乳者放牧勿殺。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: livestock of the Cattle and Sheep Office that had young were to graze freely and not be slaughtered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he ordered the Cattle and Sheep Office to spare nursing herds and let them range.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，朝陵，緣路禁樂。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: he attended the tombs; music was forbidden along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he paid court at the tombs; music was banned along the road.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，幸秦國長公主第，又幸北宅視德鈞疾。

translations.literal: Day renchen: he visited the Elder Princess of Qin’s residence, then the North Residence to inquire after Dejun’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he called on the Qin princess, then on the North Residence to see the ailing Dejun.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西涼府龕谷十族、高溪州、風琶溪洞諸蠻酋來貢。

translations.literal: That year the ten Qian Valley clans of Xiliang prefecture, Gaoxi prefecture, and the Fengpa Brook cave chiefs came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qian Valley’s ten clans, Gaoxi, and Fengpa Brook cave lords sent tribute from Xiliang.

sentences.zh: 京東西、河北、陝西饑，振之。

translations.literal: Jingdong, Jingxi, Hebei, and Shaanxi suffered famine; relief was given.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck Jingdong, Jingxi, Hebei, and Shaanxi; grain relief followed.

sentences.zh: 博州蝝，不為災。

translations.literal: Bozhou had grain pests but it did not become a disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou saw grain pests but no serious harm.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己亥朔，御朝元殿受朝。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, jihai new moon: he received court at Chaoyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, new moon jihai: he held court at Chaoyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 詔：京畿繫囚流以下減一等。

translations.literal: Edict: prisoners in the capital region sentenced to exile or below had their punishments reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: An edict cut one grade from capital prisoners down to exile and below.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以陳堯叟為東京留守。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Chen Yaosou was made eastern capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Chen Yaosou became regent of the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 德鈞卒。

translations.literal: Dejun died.
translations.idiomatic: Dejun died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，契丹使辭歸國。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Khitan envoys took leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Khitan envoys departed for home.

sentences.zh: 以丁謂為隨駕三司使。

translations.literal: Ding Wei was made traveling Three Departments commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Wei was named traveling Three Departments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，車駕發京師。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the imperial carriage set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the court left the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚申，次中牟縣，除逋負，釋繫囚，賜父老衣幣，所過如之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: he halted at Zhongmou county, cleared arrears, freed prisoners, and gave elders cloth and coin; he did the same at each stop.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he stopped at Zhongmou, forgave debts, freed jails, and clothed the elders—so at every stage.

sentences.zh: 王顯卒。

translations.literal: Wang Xian died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xian died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，次永安鎮。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: he halted at Yong’an town.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he encamped at Yong’an town.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝素服詣諸陵。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the emperor in plain dress visited the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, in undyed robes, he went to the tombs.

sentences.zh: 減西京及諸路繫囚罪，如己亥詔。

translations.literal: Sentences of prisoners in the western capital and on the circuits were reduced, as in the jihai edict.
translations.idiomatic: Western capital and circuit prisoners received the same one-grade reduction as the jihai edict.

sentences.zh: 置永安縣及三陵副使、都監。

translations.literal: Yong’an county was established, with deputy commissioners and chief overseers for the three tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Yong’an county was founded and deputies and chief overseers were set over the three tombs.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，幸西京，經漢將軍紀信塚、司徒魯恭廟，贈信太尉、恭太師。

translations.literal: Second month, day jisi: he visited the western capital, passed the tomb of Han general Ji Xin and the shrine of Minister Lu Gong, and posthumously granted Xin Grand Marshal and Gong Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jisi: reaching Luoyang he passed Ji Xin’s tomb and Lu Gong’s shrine and raised Xin to Grand Marshal and Gong to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 命吏部尚書張齊賢祭周六廟。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Zhang Qixian was ordered to sacrifice at the six temples of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qixian, Minister of Personnel, was sent to offer at Zhou’s six temples.

sentences.zh: 詔從官先塋在洛者賜告祭拜。

translations.literal: Edict: attendant officials whose ancestral graves were at Luoyang were granted leave to worship.
translations.idiomatic: Courtiers with family graves in Luoyang were given leave to make offerings.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔西京建太祖神御殿。

translations.literal: Day guiyou, edict: a spirit hall to Taizu was to be built in the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he ordered a Taizu spirit hall raised in Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 置國子監、武成王廟。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Education and the Temple of King Wu Cheng were established.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the Directorate of Education and the Temple of King Wu Cheng.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸上清宮。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: he visited Shangqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he visited Shangqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 詔賜酺三日。

translations.literal: Edict: a three-day public feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted three days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，錄唐白居易孫利用為河南府助教。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Li Yong, grandson of Tang Bai Juyi, was enrolled as assistant instructor of Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Bai Juyi’s grandson Li Yong was made an assistant instructor in Henan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸呂蒙正第。

translations.literal: Day renwu: he visited Lyu Mengzheng’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he called on Lyu Mengzheng.

sentences.zh: 甲申，御五鳳樓觀酺，召父老五百人，賜飲樓下。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: from Wufeng Tower he watched the feast, summoned five hundred elders, and gave them drink below the tower.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he watched the revels from Wufeng Tower and gave five hundred elders drink at its foot.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸元偓宮。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: he visited Yuanwei Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he visited Yuanwei Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，葺周六廟。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the six temples of Zhou were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhou’s six temples were restored.

sentences.zh: 加號列子。

translations.literal: An honorific title was added for Liezi.
translations.idiomatic: Liezi received an added honorific title.

sentences.zh: 增封唐孝子潘良瑗及其子季通墓，仍禁樵採。

translations.literal: The tombs of Tang filial son Pan Liangyuan and his son Jitong were enlarged and protected, and fuel-gathering was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The graves of Tang filial Pan Liangyuan and his son Jitong were enlarged and placed off limits to woodcutters.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔河南府置五代漢高祖廟。

translations.literal: Day gengyin, edict: Henan prefecture was to establish a temple to Gaozu of Later Han of the Five Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he ordered Henan to build a shrine to Later Han’s founding emperor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，車駕發西京。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the imperial carriage set out from the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the court left Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，次鄭州，遣使祀中嶽及周嵩、懿二陵。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: he halted at Zhengzhou and sent envoys to sacrifice at Mount Song and the Zhou tombs of Song and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he stopped at Zhengzhou and sent envoys to Mount Song and the Zhou tombs of Song and Yi.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賜隱士楊璞繒帛。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the recluse Yang Pu was given silk and brocade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the hermit Yang Pu received silk and brocade.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，至自西京。

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai: he returned from the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jihai: he came back from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，謁啟聖院太宗神御殿。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: he paid homage at Taizong’s spirit hall in Qisheng Cloister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he worshipped at Taizong’s spirit hall in Qisheng Cloister.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，趙德明遣使來謝廩給，因貢駝馬，優賜答之。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zhao Deming sent envoys to thank him for grain stipends and presented camels and horses; generous gifts were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Zhao Deming’s envoys thanked the court for grain and brought camels and horses; rich return gifts followed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔天下收瘞遺骸，致祭。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: exposed bones empire-wide were to be gathered and buried with rites.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he ordered the realm to collect unburied remains and give them funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 庚申，蠲河南府倉庫吏逋負芻糧緡帛四十五萬。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Henan prefecture granary clerks’ arrears in fodder, grain, and cash—450,000—were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Henan granary clerks were forgiven 450,000 in overdue fodder, grain, and cash.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，詔嶺南官除赴以時，以避炎瘴。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiyou, edict: Lingnan officials were to take up posts on schedule to avoid malarial heat.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, guiyou: Lingnan appointees were told to report on time and avoid the fever season.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，皇后郭氏崩。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Empress Guo died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Empress Guo died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔榷酤不得增課。

translations.literal: Day jiawu, edict: monopoly liquor taxes were not to be increased.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he forbade raising the liquor monopoly levy.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingshen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, new moon bingshen: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，有司上大行皇后諡曰莊穆。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the ministries proposed the late empress’s posthumous title Zhuangmu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the ministries offered the late empress the title Zhuangmu.

sentences.zh: 減并、代戍兵屯河東，以省饋運。

translations.literal: Garrison troops at Bing and Dai were reduced and stationed in Hedong to save transport costs.
translations.idiomatic: Bing and Dai garrisons were cut and shifted to Hedong to ease supply lines.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幸元偁宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: he visited Yuanqian Palace to inquire after an illness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he called at Yuanqian Palace to see the sick.

sentences.zh: 兗州增二千戶守孔子墳。

translations.literal: Yanzhou’s quota to guard Confucius’ tomb was increased by two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou gained two thousand households assigned to tend Confucius’ grave.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊辰，減劍、隴等三十九州軍歲貢物，夔、賀等二十七州軍悉罷之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day wuchen: annual tribute goods from thirty-nine prefectures and armies including Jian and Long were reduced; twenty-seven including Qian and He were abolished entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, wuchen: tribute from thirty-nine circuits including Jian and Long was cut; twenty-seven including Qian and He were ended outright.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸秦國長公主第省疾。

translations.literal: Day jisi: he visited the Elder Princess of Qin’s residence to inquire after her illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he called on the Qin princess to see how she fared.

sentences.zh: 壬申，御試制科舉人。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the emperor personally examined decree-examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he held the imperial decree examination.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔張齊賢等各舉供奉官、侍禁、殿直有謀略武幹知邊事者二人。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: Zhang Qixian and each of the others were to recommend two palace attendants, inner guards, or palace guards of proven strategy, martial talent, and frontier knowledge.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhang Qixian and the rest were each to name two attendants, inner guards, or palace guards skilled in strategy and border affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔：開封府斷獄，雖被旨仍覆奏。

translations.literal: Day guisi, edict: when Kaifeng prefecture decided cases, even on imperial order it was still to report back for review.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Kaifeng was told that even imperial orders in capital trials required a follow-up memorial.

sentences.zh: 六月，盛暑，減京城役工日課之半。

translations.literal: Sixth month, in extreme heat, corvée laborers in the capital had their daily quota halved.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month’s heat, capital corvée quotas were cut in half.

sentences.zh: 丁未，令翰林講讀、樞密直學士各舉常參官一人充御史。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Hanlin readers and direct academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs were each to recommend one regular attendee for censor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Hanlin readers and Bureau of Military Affairs academicians each nominated one regular official for the censorate.

sentences.zh: 司天監言五星聚而伏於鶉火。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy reported the five planets gathered and hid in the Chunhuo asterism.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomers reported the five planets in conjunction, then hidden in Chunhuo.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，葬莊穆皇后。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Zhuangmu empress was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhuangmu empress was interred.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，莊穆皇后祔別廟。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingmao: Zhuangmu empress was enshrined in a separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, dingmao: Zhuangmu empress entered her own spirit temple.

sentences.zh: 庚午，置靈臺令。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the office of Director of the Spirit Terrace was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the post of Director of the Spirit Terrace was created.

sentences.zh: 壬申，增置開封府判官、推官各一員。

translations.literal: Day renshen: one additional judge and one additional investigator were added to Kaifeng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Kaifeng gained an extra judge and an extra investigator.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，宜州兵亂，軍校陳進殺知州劉永規等，劫判官盧成均為首。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Yizhou troops mutinied; army officer Chen Jin killed prefect Liu Yonggui and others and forced judge Lu Chengjun to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Yizhou mutinied; Chen Jin slew prefect Liu Yonggui and the rest and made judge Lu Chengjun their chief.

sentences.zh: 詔閤門使曹利用等討之。

translations.literal: Edict: Palace Gate commissioner Cao Liyong and others were to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Liyong and fellow Palace Gate commissioners were sent to crush the revolt.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，交州來貢，賜黎龍廷九經及佛氏書。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Jiaozhou came to offer tribute; Li Longting was given the Nine Classics and Buddhist texts.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Jiaozhou tribute arrived; Li Longting received the Nine Classics and Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以龍廷為靜海軍節度、交阯郡王，賜名至忠。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Longting was made military commissioner of Jinghai and Prince of Jiaozhi; he was granted the name Zhizhong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Longting became Jinghai commissioner and Prince of Jiaozhi, taking the granted name Zhizhong.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，復置諸路提點刑獄。

translations.literal: Day guisi: circuit commissioners for penal affairs were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi circuit penal commissioners were restored.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，幸大相國寺，遂幸崇文院觀書，賜修書官器幣。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin: he visited the Great Xiangguo Monastery, then Chongwen Hall to view books and gave vessels and cloth to the collators.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renyin: he toured Xiangguo Monastery, then Chongwen Hall’s library and rewarded the editors with gifts.

sentences.zh: 又幸內藏庫。

translations.literal: He also visited the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: He also inspected the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 丁未，中書門下言莊穆皇后祥除已久，秋宴請舉樂，不允。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the Secretariat reported that mourning for Zhuangmu empress had long ended and asked permission for music at the autumn feast; it was denied.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the Secretariat pleaded that Zhuangmu’s mourning was long past and asked music at the autumn feast; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 己酉，頒宜州立功將士賞格。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: reward scales for meritorious soldiers of Yizhou were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou bounty tables for Yizhou’s victorious troops were published.

sentences.zh: 益州地震。

translations.literal: Yizhou was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou quaked.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜文宣王四十六世孫聖佑同學究出身。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Sheng You, forty-sixth-generation descendant of the Cultured King, was granted the same standing as a provincial investigation scholar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Sheng You, forty-sixth in line from Confucius, received investigation-scholar standing.

sentences.zh: 壬子，邢昺加工部尚書。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Xing Bing was promoted to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Xing Bing was made Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 中書門下再表請秋宴聽樂，又不允。

translations.literal: The Secretariat again memorialized asking that the autumn feast be allowed music; again it was denied.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat again begged music for the autumn feast; again the emperor said no.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，涇原路言瓦亭砦地震。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Jingyuan circuit reported an earthquake at Wating Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Jingyuan reported a quake at Wating Fort.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔王旦、楊億等修太祖、太宗史。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: Wang Dan, Yang Yi, and others were to compile the histories of Taizu and Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Wang Dan, Yang Yi, and others were ordered to compile Taizu and Taizong’s histories.

sentences.zh: 置龍圖閣直學士，以右諫議大夫杜鎬為之。

translations.literal: The office of direct academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall was established; Right Remonstrance Censor Du Hao was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Diagram Hall direct academicians were created; Right Remonstrance Du Hao took the post.

sentences.zh: 丁謂上景德會計錄。

translations.literal: Ding Wei presented the Jingde fiscal accounts.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Wei submitted the Jingde fiscal ledger.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，賜交阯郡王印及安南旌節。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jisi: the seal of Prince of Jiaozhi and the Annam regalia were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jisi: the Prince of Jiaozhi’s seal and Annam insignia were granted.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜畿縣聖惠方。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the Holy Benevolence formula was bestowed on metropolitan counties.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen metropolitan counties received the Holy Benevolence prescription.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸舒王宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: he visited Prince of Shu’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he called at Prince of Shu’s house to see him through his illness.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賜監修國史王旦宴。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: a feast was granted to Wang Dan, supervisor of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the court fêted Wang Dan, overseer of the state annals.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，日上有五色雲。

translations.literal: Day renchen: five-colored clouds appeared on the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen iridescent clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午朔，日當食，雲陰不見。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon jiawu: an eclipse was due but clouds hid it.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiawu new moon: clouds veiled the expected eclipse.

sentences.zh: 曹利用破賊於象州，擒盧成均，斬陳進。

translations.literal: Cao Liyong defeated rebels at Xiang prefecture, captured Lu Chengjun, and beheaded Chen Jin.
translations.idiomatic: At Xiangzhou Cao Liyong broke the rebels, took Lu Chengjun, and executed Chen Jin.

sentences.zh: 優賜將士，利用等進秩賜物有差。

translations.literal: Generous rewards were given the troops; Liyong and others were advanced in rank with differentiated gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The army was richly rewarded; Liyong and his officers were promoted and gifted by degree.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，頒考試進士新格。

translations.literal: Day yisi: new rules for the jinshi examination were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi new standards for the jinshi exams were issued.

sentences.zh: 祠祭置監祭使二員，以御史充。

translations.literal: Two supervisory sacrifice commissioners were established for temple rites, filled by censors.
translations.idiomatic: Temple worship gained two overseers, both drawn from the censorate.

sentences.zh: 詔翰林學士晁迥等舉常參官可知大藩者二人。

translations.literal: Edict: Hanlin academician Chao Huan and others were to recommend two regular attendees fit to govern great circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Chao Huan and fellow Hanlin readers were to name two officials each fit for a major prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，升象州為防禦。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Xiang prefecture was raised to defense command.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Xiangzhou became a defense prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔：「宜、柳、象州、懷遠軍死罪以下，非十惡、謀故鬬殺、官吏犯枉法贓者，並原之。

translations.literal: Day jiayin, edict: "In Yi, Liu, Xiang prefectures and Huaiyuan army, all below death penalty except the ten abominations, plotted or intentional killing in brawl, and officials guilty of corrupt law—are pardoned."
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he pardoned non-capital offenders in Yi, Liu, Xiang, and Huaiyuan, sparing the ten grave crimes, deliberate murder, and official graft.

sentences.zh: 廣南東、西路雜犯死罪以下遞減一等，脅從受署者勿理。

translations.literal: In Guangnan East and West circuits miscellaneous offenses below death were reduced one grade; those coerced into taking office were not prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: East and West Guangnan saw capital cases cut one degree; men forced into rebel titles went untouched.

sentences.zh: 蠲宜、柳、象州、懷遠軍丁錢及夏秋租，桂、昭州秋租。

translations.literal: Yi, Liu, Xiang, Huaiyuan poll tax and summer-autumn rents were remitted, as were Guilin and Zhao autumn rents.
translations.idiomatic: Poll duties and harvest levies were lifted in Yi, Liu, Xiang, Huaiyuan, Guilin, and Zhao.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，毀諸道官司非法訊囚之具。

translations.literal: Day yimao: illegal torture implements of official offices in all circuits were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao every circuit was ordered to smash unlawful interrogation tools.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，日南至，御朝元殿受朝。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuchen: winter solstice; he held court at Chaoyuan Hall to receive homage.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuchen solstice: he took homage at Chaoyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 曹利用等言招安賊黨，其饋賊食物者，請追捕減死論，詔釋不問。

translations.literal: Cao Liyong and others said that among pacified rebels, those who had fed the bandits should be pursued and sentenced to reduced death; an edict released them from inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Liyong urged reduced-death charges for villagers who had fed the rebels; the emperor pardoned them instead.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，賜近臣、契丹錦綺綾縠等物。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai: brocades, silks, gauzes, and damasks were bestowed on close ministers and the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jihai: court favorites and Khitan envoys received brocades and silks.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，廢兗州鐵冶。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Yanzhou’s ironworks were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Yanzhou’s iron smeltery was shut down.

sentences.zh: 己未，甘州僧翟大秦等獻馬，給其直。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Ganzhou monks Zhai Daqin and others presented horses and were paid their value.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Ganzhou monks led by Zhai Daqin offered horses and were paid in full.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河西六谷、夏州、沙州、大食、占城、蒲端國、西南蕃溪峒蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year Hexi’s Six Valleys, Xia, Shazhou, Dashi, Champa, Puan, and southwestern stream-cave tribes sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute arrived from Hexi Six Valleys, Xia, Shazhou, Dashi, Champa, Puan, and southwestern chieftains.

sentences.zh: 雄州、安肅、廣信饑。

translations.literal: Xiong, Ansui, and Guangxin prefectures suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck Xiongzhou, Ansui, and Guangxin.

sentences.zh: 宛丘、東阿、須城縣蝗，不為災。

translations.literal: Wanqiu, Dong’a, and Xucheng counties had locusts but no disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts appeared in Wanqiu, Dong’a, and Xucheng without crop failure.

sentences.zh: 諸路豐稔，淮、蔡間麥斗十錢，粳米斛二百。

translations.literal: All circuits were abundant; between Huai and Cai wheat sold for ten cash a dou and polished rice two hundred a hu.
translations.idiomatic: Harvests ran rich empire-wide; Huai-Cai wheat was ten cash a dou, rice two hundred a hu.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰，御乾元門觀酺，賜父老千五百人衣服、茶綵。

translations.literal: Second month, day renchen: he viewed the feast at Qianyuan Gate and gave clothes and tea-silk to fifteen hundred elders.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renchen: at Qianyuan Gate he watched the public feast and clothed fifteen hundred elders.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，分遣中使六人錫邊臣宴。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: six palace envoys were dispatched to grant frontier officers banquets.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou six inner envoys carried banquets to border commanders.

sentences.zh: 丙午，申明非命服勿服銷金，及不許以金銀為箔之制。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: it was clarified that non-prescribed garments must not use gilding, and gold or silver foil was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the court restated bans on gilded dress and on gold or silver leaf as ornament.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，兗州父老千二百人詣闕請封禪；

translations.literal: Third month, day jiaxu: twelve hundred Yanzhou elders came to court to request a feng-shan.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiaxu: twelve hundred Yanzhou elders petitioned for a Mount Tai rite.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，兗州并諸路進士等八百四十人詣闕請封禪；

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Yanzhou together with jinshi candidates empire-wide, eight hundred forty persons, came to court to request feng-shan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Yanzhou and eight hundred forty examination candidates from every route begged for feng-shan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，文武官、將校、蠻夷、耆壽、僧道二萬四千三百七十餘人詣闕請封禪，不允。

translations.literal: Day renwu: civil and military officials, officers, barbarians, elders, monks and Daoists—more than twenty-four thousand three hundred seventy—came to court to request feng-shan; it was denied.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu over twenty-four thousand officials, soldiers, tribesmen, elders, and clergy petitioned for feng-shan and were refused.

sentences.zh: 自是表凡五上。

translations.literal: From this time memorials requesting it were submitted five times in all.
translations.idiomatic: Five more such petitions would follow.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，詔以十月有事于泰山，遣官告天地、宗廟、嶽瀆諸祠。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu: an edict fixed the tenth month for rites at Mount Tai and sent officers to announce Heaven, the ancestral temple, and mountain-river shrines.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiawu: October’s Tai Shan rites were proclaimed and envoys notified Heaven, ancestors, and sacred peaks.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以知樞密院事王欽若、參知政事趙安仁為泰山封禪經度制置使。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Privy Council director Wang Qinruo and Vice Grand Councilor Zhao Anren were made commissioners for planning the Mount Tai feng-shan.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Wang Qinruo and Zhao Anren took charge of feng-shan logistics.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以王旦為封禪大禮使，馮拯、陳堯叟分掌禮儀使。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Wang Dan was made chief ritual commissioner; Feng Zheng and Chen Yaosou divided the ritual commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wang Dan headed the rites; Feng Zheng and Chen Yaosou shared ritual duties.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸元偁宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: he visited Prince of Shu’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he again called at Prince of Shu’s sickbed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，御試禮部貢舉人。

translations.literal: Day renyin: he personally examined metropolitan examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he held the palace examination for presented scholars.

sentences.zh: 丙午，作昭應宮。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Zhaoying Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu work began on Zhaoying Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸秦國長公主第省疾。

translations.literal: Day wushen: he visited the Qin State elder princess’s residence to inquire after her illness.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he called on the ailing Qin State elder princess.

sentences.zh: 又幸晉國、魯國長公主第，並賜白金千兩、彩二千匹。

translations.literal: He also visited the Jin and Lu elder princesses’ residences and gave each a thousand taels of white gold and two thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: He called on the Jin and Lu princesses as well, gifting each a thousand taels of silver and two thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 曹、濟州、廣濟軍耆老二千二百人詣闕請臨幸。

translations.literal: Twelve hundred elders of Cao, Jizhou, and Guangji army came to court requesting an imperial visit.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve hundred elders from Cao, Jizhou, and Guangji begged the emperor to visit.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，王欽若言泰山醴泉出，錫山蒼龍見。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu: Wang Qinruo said an auspicious spring had appeared on Mount Tai and a blue dragon was seen on Xici Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renxu: Wang Qinruo reported a sacred spring on Tai Shan and a blue dragon on Xici Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔瘞汴、蔡、廣濟河流屍暴骸，仍致祭。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: an edict ordered drowned corpses and exposed bones in the Bian, Cai, and Guangji river courses to be buried and sacrifices offered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he ordered the Bian, Cai, and Guangji waterways searched for the dead, buried with rites.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸南宮視惟能疾。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: he visited the Southern Palace to inquire after Weineng’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he called at the Southern Palace to see Weineng.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔緣路行宮舊屋止加塗塈，毋別創。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict said roadside palaces’ old buildings were only to be replastered, not rebuilt anew.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he forbade new construction along the route—old lodges were to be patched, not replaced.

sentences.zh: 癸未，置天書儀衛使副、扶侍使都監、夾侍，凡有大禮即命之。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: deputy directors of Celestial Text guard, chief ushers, and flank attendants were established, to be appointed whenever great rites occurred.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei posts were created for Celestial Text guards and ushers, filled whenever major rites were held.

sentences.zh: 詔離京至封禪以前不舉樂，所經州縣勿以聲伎來迓。

translations.literal: Edict: from leaving the capital until feng-shan, music was not to be performed; counties along the route must not greet him with performers.
translations.idiomatic: Until the rites ended, the march would be silent and counties were barred from sending musicians to meet him.

sentences.zh: 甲申，放後宮一百二十人。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: one hundred twenty women of the inner quarters were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen a hundred twenty palace women were sent home.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔：除乘輿供帳，存於禮文者如舊，自今宮禁中外進奉物，勿以銷金文繡為飾。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: except for the imperial train’s furnishings preserved in ritual texts, from now on tribute from palace and court must not use gilded embroidery as ornament.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he banned gilded embroidery on all gifts save ritual furnishings for the imperial train.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，天書再降于泰山醴泉北。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiwei: the Celestial Text descended again north of Mount Tai’s auspicious spring.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yiwei: the Celestial Text appeared again north of Tai Shan’s sacred spring.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔宮苑皇親臣庶第宅飾以五綵，及用羅製幡勝、繒帛為假花者，並禁之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: an edict forbade princely and common mansions to be decorated in five colors, and banned silk victory banners and brocade sham flowers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou five-color house paint, silk festival banners, and brocade false flowers were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，迎泰山天書於含芳園，雲五色見，俄黃氣如鳳駐殿上。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Mount Tai Celestial Text was welcomed at Hanfang Garden; five-colored clouds appeared, and soon yellow vapor like a phoenix rested on the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Tai Shan Celestial Text entered Hanfang Garden amid five-colored clouds and yellow mist shaped like a phoenix on the hall.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，曲赦兗州繫囚流罪以下。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: a partial amnesty was granted to Yanzhou prisoners below exile.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Yanzhou jails were opened for all below exile.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，群臣表上尊號曰崇文廣武儀天尊道寶應章感聖明仁孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the ministers submitted a honorific title: Sagely, Civil, Broadly Martial, Rites-Honoring, Heaven-Respecting, Way-Treasuring, Responsive, Sagely Bright, Benevolent, Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the court offered the title Sagely Civil Broadly Martial Rites-Honoring Heaven-Respecting Way-Treasuring Responsive Sagely Bright Benevolent Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengshen: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengshen: Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔：諸州市上供物，非土地所宜者罷之。

translations.literal: Day bingyin, edict: tribute goods from market towns that were not native products of the land were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he ended non-local tribute items forced on market towns.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，上太祖尊諡曰啟運立極英武聖文神德玄功大孝皇帝，太宗曰至仁應道神功聖德文武大明廣孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou: Taizu’s posthumous title was raised to Founding, Epoch-Establishing, Heroically Martial, Sagely Civil, Divinely Virtuous, Mysteriously Meritorious, Greatly Filial Emperor; Taizong’s to Utmost Benevolence, Responsive Way, Divine Merit, Sagely Virtue, Civilly Martial, Greatly Bright, Broadly Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jichou: Taizu and Taizong received lengthened temple names befitting founders of the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔東封道路軍馬毋犯民稼，開封府毋治道役民。

translations.literal: Day gengyin, edict: army horses on the eastern-feng route must not trample the people’s crops; Kaifeng was not to press the people for road work.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he forbade trampling crops along the feng-shan road and exempted Kaifeng from corvée for the route.

sentences.zh: 庚子，置河東緣邊安撫司。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the Hedong frontier pacification office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi a Hedong frontier pacification bureau was created.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，黔州言磨嵯、洛浦蠻首領龔行滿等率族二千三百人內附。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Qian prefecture reported that Mocuo and Luopu tribal chiefs Gong Xingman and others led two thousand three hundred clansmen to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Qianzhou reported Mocuo and Luopu chiefs led twenty-three hundred tribesmen inward.

sentences.zh: 己酉，王欽若獻芝草八千餘本。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Wang Qinruo presented more than eight thousand stalks of auspicious fungus.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Wang Qinruo offered over eight thousand stalks of sacred fungus.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，令有司勿奏大辟案。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: offices were ordered not to memorialize capital cases.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuwu: capital sentences were halted from the docket.

sentences.zh: 岳州進三脊茅。

translations.literal: Yue prefecture presented three-ridged thatch.
translations.idiomatic: Yuezhou sent three-ridged ritual thatch.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以向敏中權東京留守。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Xiang Minzhong was made acting eastern capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Xiang Minzhong became acting regent at the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 甲子，奉天書告太廟，悉陳諸州所上芝草、嘉禾、瑞木於仗內。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Celestial Text was announced at the imperial temple; all auspicious fungus, fine grain, and propitious trees presented by prefectures were displayed within the guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Celestial Text reached the ancestral temple amid a parade of sacred fungus, grain, and trees from every prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，幸元偓宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: he visited Prince of Shu’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he called again at Prince of Shu’s sickroom.

sentences.zh: 壬申，知晉州齊化基坐貪暴削籍，流崖州。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Qi prefecture magistrate Qi Huaji was stripped of register for greed and violence and exiled to Yazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Jinzhou’s Qi Huaji was disbarred for extortion and sent to Yazhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸潛龍園宴射。

translations.literal: Day yihai: he visited Hidden Dragon Garden for a banquet and archery.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he feasted and shot at Hidden Dragon Garden.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸惟吉宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: he visited Weineng’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he called at Weineng’s house.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，西京諸州民以車駕東巡貢獻，召對勞賜之。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: western capital prefectures’ people brought tribute because the carriage was touring east; they were summoned, addressed, and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin western capital folk who had sent gifts for the eastern tour were received and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以馬知節為行宮都部署。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Ma Zhijie was made marshal of the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Ma Zhijie took command of the march encampment.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，趙安仁獻五色金玉丹、紫芝八千七百餘本。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Zhao Anren presented five-colored jade-gold elixir pills and more than eight thousand seven hundred stalks of purple fungus.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Zhao Anren offered polychrome elixir pills and eighty-seven hundred purple fungus stalks.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，親習封禪儀于崇德殿。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: he personally rehearsed feng-shan rites in Chongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he drilled the Tai Shan rites in Chongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，上御蔬食。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuzi: the emperor took plain food.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuzi: he began a vegetarian fast.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以巡幸置考制度使、副，凡巡幸則命之。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: directors and deputies for touring-examination regulations were established, to be appointed on every tour.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin touring-examination commissioners were instituted for each imperial journey.

sentences.zh: 是夕，五星順行同色。

translations.literal: That night the five planets moved direct and shared the same color.
translations.idiomatic: That night all five planets ran direct and matched hue.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，車駕發京師，扶侍使奉天書先道。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the imperial carriage set out from the capital; ushers bore the Celestial Text ahead.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the court left Kaifeng, the Celestial Text borne before the train.

sentences.zh: 丙申，次澶州，宴周瑩於行宮。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: he halted at Cao prefecture and feasted Zhou Ying at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he stopped at Caozhou and banqueted Zhou Ying.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，許、鄆、齊等州長吏赴泰山陪位。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: magistrates of Xu, Yan, and Qi prefectures were summoned to accompany him at Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu prefects of Xu, Yan, and Qi were called to stand at Tai Shan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，駐蹕鄆州，神光起昊天玉冊上。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: he encamped at Yan prefecture; divine light rose upon the Jade Register of High Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou at Yanzhou sacred light flared on the Jade Register of High Heaven.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔扈從人毋壞民舍、什器、樹木。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, edict: those in the entourage must not damage people’s houses, utensils, or trees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he forbade the escort to harm homes, goods, or trees.

sentences.zh: 丁未，法駕入乾封縣奉高宮。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the imperial train entered Fenggao county’s Fenggao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the procession entered Fenggao Palace in Fenggao county.

sentences.zh: 戊申，王欽若等獻泰山芝草三萬八千餘本。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wang Qinruo and others presented more than thirty-eight thousand stalks of Mount Tai fungus.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Wang Qinruo offered thirty-eight thousand Tai Shan fungus stalks.

sentences.zh: 己酉，五色雲起嶽頂。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: five-colored clouds rose from the mountain’s summit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou five-colored clouds crowned the peak.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，法駕臨山門，黃雲覆輦，道經險峻，降輦步進。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the train reached the mountain gate; yellow clouds covered the carriage; where the path was steep he descended and walked.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu at the mountain gate yellow mist veiled the palanquin; on steep grades he walked.

sentences.zh: 先夕大風，至是頓息。

translations.literal: The night before a great wind had blown; now it suddenly ceased.
translations.idiomatic: A gale the night before died at once.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，享昊天上帝於圜臺，陳天書於左，以太祖、太宗配。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: he offered to High Heaven on the round altar, the Celestial Text placed to the left, with Taizu and Taizong as associates.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he sacrificed to Heaven on the round altar, the Celestial Text at the left, Taizu and Taizong beside him.

sentences.zh: 帝袞冕奠獻，慶雲繞壇，月有黃光；

translations.literal: The emperor in full regalia made the offering; auspicious clouds circled the altar and the moon showed yellow light.
translations.idiomatic: Robed and crowned he offered; lucky clouds ringed the altar and the moon glowed gold.

sentences.zh: 命群臣享五方帝諸神於山下封祀壇，上下傳呼萬歲，振動山谷。

translations.literal: He ordered the ministers to offer to the Five Emperors and other spirits at the feng altar below; above and below cried “Long live the emperor!” and the valleys shook.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers sacrificed to the Five Emperors below; “Ten thousand years!” echoed up and down the mountain.

sentences.zh: 降谷口，日有冠戴，黃氣紛郁。

translations.literal: Descending the valley mouth, the sun wore a crown and yellow vapor swirled thick.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving the pass, the sun wore a halo and yellow mist billowed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，禪社首，如封祀儀。

translations.literal: Day renzi: he performed the shan rite at Sheshou, as in the feng ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he completed the shan rite at Sheshou in the same form as the feng.

sentences.zh: 紫氣下覆，黃光如星繞天書匣。

translations.literal: Purple vapor descended and yellow light like stars ringed the Celestial Text casket.
translations.idiomatic: Purple mist fell and starlike gold light ringed the Text’s casket.

sentences.zh: 縱四方所獻珍禽奇獸。

translations.literal: Rare birds and beasts presented from the four directions were released.
translations.idiomatic: Exotic tribute beasts from every quarter were set free.

sentences.zh: 還奉高宮，日重輪，五色雲見。

translations.literal: Returning to Fenggao Palace, the sun showed double disks and five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Back at Fenggao Palace the sun doubled and five-colored clouds shone.

sentences.zh: 作會真宮。

translations.literal: Huizhen Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: Huizhen Palace was erected.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，御朝覲壇之壽昌殿，受群臣朝賀。

translations.literal: Day guichou: he ascended Shouchang Hall of the Audience Altar and received the ministers’ congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he took homage at Shouchang Hall on the Audience Altar.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，常赦所不原者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed for the empire; even those ordinary amnesties did not cover were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a great amnesty wider than any routine pardon.

sentences.zh: 文武並進秩。

translations.literal: Civil and military ranks were advanced.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officers were promoted.

sentences.zh: 賜致仕官本品全奉一季，京朝官衣緋綠十五年者改賜服色。

translations.literal: Retired officials received one season’s full salary at their former rank; metropolitan officials who had worn purple or green fifteen years received new robe colors.
translations.idiomatic: Retirees drew a season’s full pay; capital officers of fifteen years’ purple or green gained new colors.

sentences.zh: 令開封府及所過州軍考送服勤詞學、經明行修舉人，其懷材抱器淪於下位，及高年不仕德行可稱者，所在以聞。

translations.literal: Kaifeng and every prefecture and army along the route were ordered to examine and send up candidates in diligent learning, classics, and conduct; those of talent stranded in low posts and elders of virtue who would not serve were to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: Along the route magistrates were to find hidden talent and venerable recluses and report them up.

sentences.zh: 三班使臣經五年者與考課。

translations.literal: Third-rank envoys who had served five years were given performance review.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys of the third rank after five years received merit review.

sentences.zh: 兩浙錢氏、泉州陳氏近親，蜀孟氏、湖南馬氏、荊南高氏、廣南河東劉氏子孫未食祿者，聽敘用。

translations.literal: Close kin of the Qian house of the two Zhes, the Chen house of Quanzhou, and descendants of the Meng, Ma, Gao, and Liu houses of Shu, Hunan, Jingnan, and Guangnan and Hedong who had not yet held salary were permitted to enter office.
translations.idiomatic: Unemployed kin of former regional rulers—Qian, Chen, Meng, Ma, Gao, and Liu—might now take posts.

sentences.zh: 賜天下酺三日。

translations.literal: The empire was granted three days of public feast.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of court-sponsored revelry were granted empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 改乾封縣為奉符縣。

translations.literal: Qianfeng county was renamed Fengfu county.
translations.idiomatic: Qianfeng county became Fengfu—“Receiving the Talisman.”

sentences.zh: 泰山七里內禁樵採。

translations.literal: Within seven li of Mount Tai, fuel-gathering was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Woodcutting was banned within seven li of Tai Shan.

sentences.zh: 大宴穆清殿。

translations.literal: A great banquet was held at Muqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The court feasted at Muqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 又宴近臣、泰山父老於殿門，賜父老時服、茶帛。

translations.literal: He again feasted close ministers and Mount Tai elders at the hall gate, giving elders seasonal clothes and tea-silk.
translations.idiomatic: Close ministers and Tai Shan elders banqueted at the gate; elders received clothes and tea-silk.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復常膳。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: normal meals were resumed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the fast ended and ordinary fare returned.

sentences.zh: 次太平驛，賜從官辟寒丸、花茸袍。

translations.literal: He halted at Taiping post station and gave accompanying officials cold-dispelling pills and flowery fleece robes.
translations.idiomatic: At Taiping station he gifted escorts warming pills and fleece robes.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，次兗州，以州為大都督府。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: he halted at Yan prefecture, which was made a great metropolitan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen at Yanzhou the prefecture was raised to a great defense command.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，幸曲阜縣，謁文宣王廟，鞾袍再拜。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: he visited Qufu county, paid homage at the Cultured King’s temple, and bowed twice in boots and robes.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuwu: at Qufu he twice bowed at Confucius’s temple in full dress.

sentences.zh: 幸叔梁紇堂。

translations.literal: He visited the hall of Shuliang He.
translations.idiomatic: He called at the shrine of Confucius’s father Shuliang He.

sentences.zh: 近臣分奠七十二弟子。

translations.literal: Close ministers each offered sacrifice to the seventy-two disciples.
translations.idiomatic: Each favorite minister sacrificed to one of the seventy-two disciples.

sentences.zh: 遂幸孔林，加諡孔子曰玄聖文宣王，遣官祭以太牢，給近便十戶奉塋廟，賜其家錢三十萬，帛三百匹。

translations.literal: Then he visited Confucius’s grove; Confucius’s title was raised to Mysteriously Sagely Cultured King; an officer sacrificed with the great victim; ten nearby households were given to tend the tomb; his family received three hundred thousand cash and three hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: At Kong Lin Confucius became the Mysteriously Sagely Cultured King; the court sacrificed with a great victim, endowed ten households for the tomb, and gave the clan cash and silk.

sentences.zh: 以四十六世孫聖佑為奉禮郎，近屬授官、賜出身者六人。

translations.literal: Sheng You, forty-sixth-generation descendant, was made Court Gentleman for Sacrifices; six close kin received office or examination standing.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-sixth-generation Sheng You became a sacrifice attendant; six kinsmen gained posts or degrees.

sentences.zh: 追諡齊太公曰昭烈武成王，令青州立廟；

translations.literal: Qi’s Grand Duke was posthumously titled Brightly Martial, Accomplished King, with a temple ordered in Qing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Qi was enshrined as Brightly Martial Accomplished King with a temple at Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 周文公曰文憲王，曲阜縣立廟。

translations.literal: Zhou’s Duke of Wen was titled Cultured and Constitutional King, with a temple in Qufu county.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Zhou received Cultured Constitutional King and a Qufu shrine.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜諸蕃使袍笏。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: foreign envoys were given robes and court tablets.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou tribute envoys received robes and tablets.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，次中都縣，幸廣相寺。

translations.literal: Day renxu: he halted at Zhongdu county and visited Guangxiang Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu at Zhongdu he visited Guangxiang Monastery.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，次鄆州，幸開元寺。

translations.literal: Day guihai: he halted at Yan prefecture and visited Kaiyuan Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai at Yanzhou he visited Kaiyuan Monastery.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜曲阜孔子廟經史。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the classics and histories were bestowed on Qufu’s Confucius temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Qufu’s Confucius temple received the canon in full.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸河瀆廟，加封。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: he visited the Yellow River shrine and added to its title.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he worshipped at the Yellow River shrine and raised its rank.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，曲宴永清軍節度使周瑩，賜兵士緡錢。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: a private banquet was given Yongqing army military commissioner Zhou Ying and the soldiers were given cash.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Zhou Ying was feasted privately and his troops paid in cash.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝至自泰山，奉天書還宮。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the emperor returned from Mount Tai, bringing the Celestial Text back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he came home from Tai Shan with the Celestial Text.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔以正月三日為天慶節。

translations.literal: Day renwu, edict: the third day of the first month was made Heaven’s Celebration festival.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the third day of the first month became Heaven’s Celebration Day.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命王旦奉上太祖、太宗諡冊，親享太廟。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Wang Dan was ordered to present Taizu and Taizong’s posthumous registers and the emperor personally offered at the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Wang Dan bore the founders’ posthumous books while the emperor sacrificed at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，大宴含光殿。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: a great banquet was held at Hanguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the court feasted at Hanguang Hall.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，御乾元殿受尊號。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinmao: he received the honorific title at Qianyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinmao: he accepted the new honorific at Qianyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚子，葛霸卒。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Ge Ba died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Ge Ba died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，王旦加中書侍郎兼刑部尚書；

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Wang Dan was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wang Dan became Secretariat vice director and Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 楚王元佐加太傅；

translations.literal: Prince of Chu Yuanzuo was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Chu Yuanzuo was named Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 寧王元偓為護國軍節度，舒王元偁為平江、鎮江軍節度，並兼侍中；

translations.literal: Prince of Ning Yuanwei was made Huguo army military commissioner and Prince of Shu Yuanzheng Pingjiang and Zhenjiang army commissioner, both concurrent Palace Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Princes of Ning and Shu took frontier commands and Palace Attendant rank.

sentences.zh: 廣陵郡王元儼進封榮王，安定郡公惟吉為威德軍節度，餘進秩有差。

translations.literal: Guangling commandery prince Yuanyi was advanced to Prince of Rong; Stability commandery duke Weineng became Weide army commissioner; others were advanced in rank with differences.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyi became Prince of Rong; Weineng took Weide command; the rest were promoted by degree.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，幸上清宮、景德開寶寺。

translations.literal: Day guimao: he visited Shangqing Palace and Jingde Kaibao Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he called at Shangqing Palace and Jingde Kaibao Monastery.

sentences.zh: 王欽若加禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Wang Qinruo was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qinruo became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，張齊賢為右僕射，溫仲舒、寇準並為戶部尚書，王化基、邢昺、郭贄並為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Zhang Qixian was made Right Vice Director; Wen Zhongshu and Kou Zhun were made Ministers of Revenue; Wang Huaji, Xing Bing, and Guo Zan were made Ministers of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhang Qixian became Right Vice Director; Wen Zhongshu and Kou Zhun took Revenue; three ministers took Rites.

sentences.zh: 詔：天下宮觀陵廟，名在地志，功及生民者，並加崇飾。

translations.literal: Edict: palace shrines and tombs named in local gazetteers whose merit touched the living were all to receive enhanced decoration.
translations.idiomatic: Shrines and tombs of recorded merit to the people were ordered refurbished empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以德雍、德文、德存、惟正、惟忠、惟敘、惟和、惟憲並領諸州刺史，允升、允言、允成、允寧、允中並為各衛將軍。

translations.literal: Day wushen: De Yong, De Wen, De Cun, Weizheng, Weizhong, Weixu, Weihe, and Weixian were all made prefects; Yun Sheng, Yun Yan, Yun Cheng, Yun Ning, and Yun Zhong were made generals of the guards.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen eight princes took prefectures and five took guard generalships.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸元偁宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: he visited Prince of Shu’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he called at Prince of Shu’s sickroom.

sentences.zh: 又幸元偓宮。

translations.literal: He also visited Prince of Ning’s palace.
translations.idiomatic: He called at Prince of Ning’s house as well.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，交阯郡王黎至忠加同平章事。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Jiaozhi commandery prince Li Zhizhong was made co–Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Zhizhong of Jiaozhi was named co–Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸元偁宮。

translations.literal: Day renzi: he visited Prince of Shu’s palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he called again at Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 契丹使上將軍蕭智可等來賀。

translations.literal: Khitan envoys led by General-in-Chief Xiao Zhihe came to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan General Xiao Zhihe arrived to congratulate the feng-shan.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西涼府、甘州、三佛齊、大食國、西南蕃等來賀封禪。

translations.literal: That year Xiliang prefecture, Ganzhou, Srivijaya, Dashi, and southwestern tribes came to congratulate the feng-shan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiliang, Ganzhou, Srivijaya, Dashi, and southwestern chiefs sent feng-shan congratulations.

sentences.zh: 諸路言歲稔，米斗七八錢。

translations.literal: All circuits reported abundant harvests; rice sold for seven or eight cash a dou.
translations.idiomatic: Every route reported full granaries; rice was seven or eight cash a dou.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸亥，以封禪慶成，賜宗室、輔臣襲衣、金帶、器幣。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day guihai: because the feng-shan celebration was complete, imperial kin and chief ministers were given court robes, gold belts, and vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, first month, guihai: kin and chief ministers received robes, gold belts, and gifts for the completed rites.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，置內殿承制。

translations.literal: Day yichou: inner-hall commissioners were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou inner-hall commissioners were created.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔：「誘人子弟析家產，或潛舉息錢，輒壞墳域者，令所在擒捕流配。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: "Those who entice others’ sons to divide family property, or secretly lend at interest and then ruin graves, are to be seized wherever found and exiled."
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he ordered the arrest and exile of men who enticed heirs to split estates or who ruined tombs over usury.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，詔：「讀非聖之書及屬辭浮靡者，皆嚴譴之。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: "Reading books not of the sages and composing florid, empty rhetoric are to be sternly punished."
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu heterodox books and florid prose drew stern punishment.

sentences.zh: 已鏤板文集，令轉運司擇官看詳，可者錄奏。

translations.literal: Already carved block collections were to be reviewed by transport commissioners; acceptable works were to be recorded and memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Printed anthologies were sent to transport officers for censorship before publication.

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，以陝西民饑，遣使巡撫。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: because Shaanxi people were famished, envoys were sent to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou famine in Shaanxi sent relief envoys abroad.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，改定入內內侍省內侍名職。

translations.literal: Second month, day jichou: titles within the Inner Palace and Inner Service were revised.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jichou: inner-palace eunuch titles were reorganized.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔立曲阜縣孔子廟學舍。

translations.literal: Day renchen: an edict ordered a school building at Qufu’s Confucius temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Qufu’s Confucius temple was ordered a schoolhouse.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賜撫州高年黃泰粟帛。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Fuzhou elder Huang Tai received grain and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the aged Huang Tai of Fuzhou received grain and silk.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，蠲同、華民租。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: rents of Tong and Hua were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Tong and Hua prefectures were forgiven their rents.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸大相國等寺、上清宮祈雨。

translations.literal: Day yisi: he visited the Grand Xiangguo and other monasteries and Shangqing Palace to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he prayed for rain at the Grand Xiangguo Monastery and Shangqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，遣使祠太一，祀玄冥。

translations.literal: Day wushen: envoys were sent to sacrifice to Great Unity and worship the Dark God.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen envoys sacrificed to Great Unity and the Dark God.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雨。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou rain came.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，禁毀金寶塑浮屠像。

translations.literal: Day guichou: destroying gold, treasure, or clay Buddha images was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou defacing gilded or jeweled Buddha images was banned.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以丁謂為三司使。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Ding Wei was made Three Departments commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Ding Wei took the Three Departments commission.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，日當食，陰晦不見。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen: an eclipse was due but overcast skies hid it.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingchen: clouds hid the expected eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賜京城酺。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the capital was granted a public feast.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Kaifeng received a court feast day.

sentences.zh: 己卯，左屯衛將軍允言坐稱疾不朝，降太子左衛率。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Left Vanguard Guard general Yun Yan was demoted to Left Crown Prince Guard colonel for feigning illness and absenting court.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Yun Yan was reduced to crown-prince guard colonel for shamming illness and skipping court.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，昇州火，遣御史訪民疾苦，蠲被火屋稅。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: a fire at Sheng prefecture; censors were sent to inquire into the people’s hardships and house tax in the burned zone was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuzi: Shengzhou’s fire brought censors to hear grievances and remit burned districts’ house tax.

sentences.zh: 己丑，餞种放還山。

translations.literal: Day jichou: a farewell feast was given Zhong Fang returning to the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the court banqueted Zhong Fang before his return to seclusion.

sentences.zh: 乙未，河北旱，遣使祠北岳。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Hebei suffered drought; envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Northern Peak.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Hebei drought sent envoys to the Northern Sacred Peak.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以丁謂為修昭應宮使。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Ding Wei was made commissioner for repairing Zhaoying Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Ding Wei took charge of Zhaoying Palace repairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔禁中外群臣非休暇無得群飲廢職。

translations.literal: Day renyin, edict: court and common ministers, except on leave, must not gather to drink and neglect duty.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin drinking parties that derailed office work were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 詔醫官院處方并藥賜河北避疫邊民。

translations.literal: Edict: the Medical Office’s prescriptions and medicines were to be given Hebei frontier people avoiding plague.
translations.idiomatic: Medical Office drugs were sent to Hebei border folk fleeing plague.

sentences.zh: 丙午，試服勤詞學、經明行修國監生。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: candidates in diligent learning, classics, and conduct from the Directorate were examined.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Directorate students sat the diligent-learning and classics exams.

sentences.zh: 丁未，振陝西民饑。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Shaanxi famine victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Shaanxi famine victims received relief grain.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，追封孔子弟子七十二人。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yimao: Confucius’s seventy-two disciples were posthumously enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yimao: the seventy-two disciples received posthumous ranks.

sentences.zh: 罷韶州獻頻婆果。

translations.literal: Shaozhou’s tribute of pinpo fruit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozhou was excused from sending pinpo fruit.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣使陝西決獄，流罪以下減一等，死罪情可憫者上請。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: envoys were sent to Shaanxi to decide cases; below exile was reduced one grade; death sentences where mercy applied were memorialized upward.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Shaanxi judges cut sentences one degree and referred merciful capital cases to the throne.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，陝西旱，遣使禱太平宮、后土、西嶽、河瀆諸祠。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Shaanxi drought; envoys were sent to pray at Taiping Palace, Queen of Earth, Western Peak, and river shrines.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Shaanxi drought sent prayers to Taiping Palace, Houtu, the Western Peak, and river gods.

sentences.zh: 代州地震。

translations.literal: Dai prefecture was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Daizhou quaked.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，頒幕職、州縣官招集戶口賞條。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiyou: regulations rewarding prefectural and county officials for gathering population were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yiyou: new bounties were issued for magistrates who grew household registers.

sentences.zh: 甲午，幸昭應宮，賜修宮使器幣。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: he visited Zhaoying Palace and gave the repair commissioner vessels and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he toured Zhaoying Palace and rewarded its builders.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，保州增屯田務兵三百人。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Baozhou’s garrison farm was increased by three hundred soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Baozhou’s farm garrison gained three hundred men.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，麟府言社慶族依唐龍鎮為援，數擾別部，請出兵襲之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Lin and Fu reported that the Sheqing clan, relying on Tang’s Long Fort as support, repeatedly harassed other tribes and asked to send troops to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Lin-Fu reported Sheqing raiders sheltered by Long Fort and sought permission to attack.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「均吾民也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "They are equally my people."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "They are all my subjects alike."

sentences.zh: 」不許。

translations.literal: It was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔量留五坊鷹鶻，備諸王從時展禮，餘悉縱之。

translations.literal: Day renyin, edict: a measured number of hawks and falcons from the five workshops were to be kept for princes’ occasional rites; the rest were all released.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he kept only enough royal hawks for princely ceremony and freed the rest.

sentences.zh: 罷邕、宜州歲貢藥箭。

translations.literal: Yong and Yi prefectures’ annual tribute of medicinal arrows was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Yong and Yi were excused from sending medicinal arrows.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，御試東封路服勤詞學、經明行修貢舉梁固等九十二人。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: he personally examined ninety-two presented scholars in diligent learning and classics from the eastern-feng route.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he examined ninety-two feng-shan-route scholars in diligent learning and classics.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，詔張齊賢等各舉才堪御史者一人。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiayin, edict: Zhang Qixian and others were each to recommend one man fit to be censor.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiayin: Zhang Qixian and peers were each to name one man fit for the censorate.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，置糾察在京刑獄司。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the office for investigating capital punishments in the capital was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi a capital-case review office was created in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，復以萬安宮為滋福殿。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Wan’an Palace was again renamed Zifu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Wan’an Palace became Zifu Hall again.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸惟吉宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day jisi: he visited Weineng’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he called at Weineng’s sickroom.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以昭應宮為玉清昭應宮。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Zhaoying Palace was made Jade Clarity Zhaoying Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhaoying Palace was titled Jade Clarity Zhaoying Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，蠲京東徐、濟七州水災田租。

translations.literal: Day yihai: rents of seven Jingdong prefectures struck by flood were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai seven flooded Jingdong prefectures were forgiven their rents.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔孔子廟配享魯史左丘明等十九人加封爵。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: the nineteen men enshrined with Confucius, including Zuo Qiuming, were given added noble titles.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin nineteen Confucian temple associates, including Zuo Qiuming, received higher posthumous ranks.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蠲天下封禪赦前逋負千二百六十六萬緡。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: empire-wide arrears before the feng-shan amnesty—12,660,000 strings—were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen twelve million six hundred sixty thousand strings of pre-amnesty debt were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，京東惠民河溢，居民避水所過津渡，戒有司勿算。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: the Jingdong Benefiting-the-People Canal overflowed; people fleeing water at ferries were ordered not to be charged.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingxu: Jingdong’s Benefiting-the-People Canal flooded and ferry tolls were waived for refugees.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，西南蕃龍漢王堯來貢，賀東封，加漢王堯寧德大將軍。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: southwestern tribal Dragon-Han king Yao came to court to congratulate the eastern feng and was made Ningde Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Dragon-Han king Yao congratulated the eastern rites and was named Ningde Grand General.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，賜秦州被水民粟人一斛。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: Qinzhou flood victims each received one hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuwu: Qinzhou flood victims received a hu of grain each.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，合鎮、定部署為一。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Zhen and Ding commands were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhen and Ding deployments were united.

sentences.zh: 甲子，浚汴口。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Bian estuary was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Bian River mouth was cleared.

sentences.zh: 命工部侍郎馮起為契丹國信使。

translations.literal: Works Vice Minister Feng Qi was made Khitan credence envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Qi of the Ministry of Works was sent as envoy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，幸潛龍園宴射。

translations.literal: Day yichou: he visited Hidden Dragon Garden for a banquet and archery.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he feasted and shot again at Hidden Dragon Garden.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣使賜戎、瀘軍民辟瘴藥。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: envoys were sent to give Rong and Lu armies plague-warding drugs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Rong and Lu garrisons received anti-malaria medicines.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，無為軍言大風拔木，壞城門、營壘、民舍，壓溺者千餘人。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Wuwei army reported a great wind uprooted trees and destroyed city gates, camps, and houses; more than a thousand were crushed or drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wuwei reported a gale that uprooted trees and wrecked gates and barracks, killing over a thousand.

sentences.zh: 詔內臣恤視，蠲來年租，收瘞死者，家賜米一斛。

translations.literal: Edict: inner envoys were to comfort the victims; next year’s rent was remitted; the dead were gathered and buried; each household was given one hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Palace envoys were sent to bury the dead, remit next year’s tax, and give each household a hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，發官廩振鳳州水災。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: government granaries were opened to relieve Fengzhou flood victims.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Fengzhou flood victims were fed from state stores.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，優賞寧朔軍士。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: Ningshuo army soldiers were generously rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guimao: Ningshuo garrison troops received extra bounty.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔江、浙運粮兵卒經冬停役兩月。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: Jiang-Zhe grain-transport soldiers were granted two months’ winter rest from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Jiang-Zhe transport troops were given two winter months free of labor duty.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔天下置天慶觀。

translations.literal: Day jiawu, edict: Heaven’s Celebration shrines were to be established empire-wide.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Heaven’s Celebration temples were ordered in every prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，兗州霖雨害稼，振恤其民。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Yanzhou’s unending rain harmed the crops; the people were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yanzhou’s rains ruined the harvest and relief was sent.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，作文武七條戒官吏。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen: seven admonitions for civil and military officials were drafted.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingchen: seven articles of official discipline were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔：諸路官吏蠹政害民，轉運使、提點刑獄官不舉察者坐之。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict: wherever circuit officials harmed the people through corrupt government and transport commissioners or judicial intendants failed to investigate, they would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi corrupt magistrates and negligent transport and judicial officers would share punishment.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，蕃部阿黎等來朝貢，授阿黎懷化司戈。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: tribal leader Ali and others came to court with tribute; Ali was made a Huaihua company commander.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou tribal chief Ali was received and made a Huaihua company commander.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，詔：晉國大長公主喪，罷承天節上壽及明年元旦朝會。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinsi, edict: because the Jin State elder princess had died, the birthday audience for Heaven’s Celebration and next year’s New Year court were canceled.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinsi: the Jin princess’s death canceled the birthday and New Year audiences.

sentences.zh: 交州黎至忠貢馴犀。

translations.literal: Jiaozhi presented a tame rhinoceros.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhi sent a trained rhinoceros.

sentences.zh: 乙未，幸惟吉宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: he visited Weineng’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he called at Weineng’s sickbed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，丁謂上封禪朝覲祥瑞圖，劉承珪上天書儀仗圖。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Ding Wei presented a chart of feng-shan audience auspices; Liu Chenggui presented a chart of Celestial Text regalia.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Ding Wei offered a chart of feng-shan omens and Liu Chenggui one of Celestial Text insignia.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸惟吉宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: he visited Weineng’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he called again at Weineng’s house.

sentences.zh: 契丹國母蕭氏卒，輟視朝。

translations.literal: The Khitan empress dowager Xiao died; court audiences were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan Empress Dowager Xiao’s death halted court audiences.

sentences.zh: 是歲，于闐、西涼府、西南蕃羅嵓州蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year Khotan, Xiliang prefecture, and Luoyan prefecture southwestern tribes sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute came from Khotan, Xiliang, and Luoyan southwestern tribes.

sentences.zh: 雄州蟲食苗即死，遣使振恤。

translations.literal: Xiong prefecture’s insects ate the seedlings and died; envoys were sent to relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: Xiongzhou’s locusts died after devouring shoots; relief envoys were dispatched.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁巳，賜建安軍父老江禹錫粟帛。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day dingsi: Jiang Yuxi of Jian’an army was given grain and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Year three, first month, dingsi: Jiang Yuxi of Jian’an army received grain and silk.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，丁謂請承天節禁屠宰刑罰，從之。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou: Ding Wei requested that on Heaven’s Celebration slaughter and punishments be forbidden; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yiyou: Ding Wei won a ban on executions and slaughter for Heaven’s Celebration Day.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，交州黎至忠卒，大校李公蘊自稱留後。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Jiaozhi’s Li Zhizhong died; senior officer Li Gongyun declared himself acting regent.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Li Zhizhong of Jiaozhi died; Li Gongyun seized acting command.

sentences.zh: 已亥，禁方春射獵，每歲春夏所在長吏申明之。

translations.literal: Day jihai: spring hunting was forbidden; each year in spring and summer local magistrates were to announce this.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai spring hunts were banned and magistrates were to proclaim the rule each spring and summer.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以張齊賢判河陽。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Zhang Qixian was assigned to Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Zhang Qixian was posted to judge Heyang.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛亥，帝御文德殿，群臣入閤。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day xinhai: the emperor held court at Wende Hall and the ministers entered the side chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, xinhai: he held court at Wende Hall while ministers entered the side chamber.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，冬官正韓顯符上新造銅候儀。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Winter Offices director Han Xianfu presented a newly cast bronze armillary.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Han Xianfu of the Winter Offices offered a new bronze armillary sphere.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔轉運司貸恤黎州夷人。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: transport commissioners were to lend and relieve the Yi people of Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Lizhou’s Yi tribes were ordered loans and famine relief.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幸開封府射堂宴射，賜開封府將吏器幣。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: he visited Kaifeng prefecture’s archery hall for a banquet and shooting and gave the prefecture’s officers vessels and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he shot and feasted at Kaifeng’s archery hall and rewarded its officers.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔：「東京畿內死罪以下遞減一等。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: "Within the eastern capital circuit, below death penalty is reduced one grade."
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen capital-region sentences below death were cut one degree.

sentences.zh: 將吏逮事太宗藩府者並賜予。

translations.literal: Officers who had served Taizong in his princely mansion were all given gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Officers who had served Taizong as prince received rewards.

sentences.zh: 赤縣父老本府宴犒，年九十者授攝官，賜粟帛終身；

translations.literal: Elders of the metropolitan counties were feasted and rewarded by the prefecture; those ninety years old were given acting office and grain and silk for life.
translations.idiomatic: Capital elders were banqueted; nonagenarians received acting rank and lifetime grain and silk.

sentences.zh: 八十者爵一級。

translations.literal: Those eighty years old received one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Octogenarians gained one noble rank.

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，以射堂為繼照堂。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the archery hall was renamed Jizhao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the archery hall became Jizhao—“Continuing the Bright.”

sentences.zh: 丁丑，召宰臣於宜聖殿，謁太宗聖容、玉皇像。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: chief ministers were summoned to Yisheng Hall to pay homage before Taizong’s sacred image and the Jade Emperor statue.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou ministers worshipped Taizong’s portrait and the Jade Emperor at Yisheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸韓國長公主第視疾。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: he visited the Han State elder princess’s residence to inquire after her illness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he called on the ailing Han State elder princess.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，以權靜海軍留後李公蘊為靜海軍節度，封交阯郡王，賜衣帶器幣。
