translations.literal: Third month, day renchen: Li Gongyun, acting Jinghai army regent, was made Jinghai military commissioner and Prince of Jiaozhi, with robes, belt, and vessels bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renchen: Li Gongyun was confirmed Jinghai commissioner and Prince of Jiaozhi with full insignia.

sentences.zh: 丙申，幸石保吉第視疾。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: he visited Shi Baoji’s residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he called at Shi Baoji’s sickroom.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔戎、瀘州給復一年，艱食者振之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou, edict: Rong and Lu prefectures were given tax relief for one year; where food was scarce the people were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Rong and Lu were tax-free for a year and famine districts received grain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，左屯衛將軍允言坐狂率，責授太子左衛副率。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinhai: Left Vanguard Guard general Yun Yan was punished for reckless conduct and demoted to Left Crown Prince Guard vice colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinhai: Yun Yan’s insolence cost him his guard generalship—he became crown-prince vice colonel.

sentences.zh: 壬子，石保吉卒。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Shi Baoji died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Shi Baoji died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，陝西民疫，遣使齎藥賜之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Shaanxi people suffered plague; envoys were sent bearing medicine.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Shaanxi’s plague sent medicine-bearing envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔中書以五月一日進中外文武升朝官及奉使歲舉官名籍。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: the Secretariat was on the first day of the fifth month to submit registers of civil and military officials attending court and of annual presenting officers at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Secretariat was ordered to file yearly rosters of capital officials and presenting officers.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜泰山隱士秦辨號貞素先生，放還山。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Mount Tai recluse Qin Bian was given the style Pure and Simple Lord and sent back to the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Tai Shan hermit Qin Bian was titled Lord Pure and Simple and returned to seclusion.

sentences.zh: 甲子，契丹國母葬，廢朝，禁邊城樂。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Khitan empress dowager was buried; court was suspended and music on the border was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Khitan mourning closed court and silenced border towns.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，加王旦兵部尚書，知樞密院事王欽若戶部尚書，陳堯叟工部尚書。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Wang Dan was made Minister of War; Privy Council director Wang Qinruo Minister of Revenue; Chen Yaosou Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Wang Dan took War, Wang Qinruo Revenue, and Chen Yaosou Works.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，幸惟吉宮視疾。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jimao: he visited Weineng’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jimao: he called again at Weineng’s sickroom.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以西涼府覓諾族瘴疫，賜藥。

translations.literal: Day renwu: because Xiliang’s Minuo clan suffered miasma, medicine was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Minuo clan of Xiliang received plague medicine.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，惟吉卒。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Weineng died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Weineng died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，京師大雨，平地數尺，壞廬舍，民有壓死者，賜布帛。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the capital had great rain; several feet in the flat ground; houses were destroyed and people crushed; cloth and silk were given.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou a cloudburst flooded the capital several feet deep, crushing houses; victims received cloth and silk.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，邊臣言契丹饑，來市糴，詔雄州糴粟二萬石振之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengxu: frontier officers reported the Khitan were famished and came to buy grain; an edict ordered Xiong prefecture to sell twenty thousand shi of grain to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengxu: Khitan famine buyers were fed from twenty thousand shi sold at Xiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 河中府父老千餘人請祀后土，不許。

translations.literal: More than a thousand elders of Hezhong prefecture requested sacrifice to Queen of Earth; it was denied.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand Hezhong elders begged a Houtu rite and were refused.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，頒天下釋奠先聖廟儀並祭器圖。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: empire-wide rites for offering to the sage’s temple and diagrams of sacrificial vessels were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen standard Confucian temple rites and vessel diagrams were issued empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 詔：前歲陝西民飢，有鬻子者，官為購贖還其家。

translations.literal: Edict: in prior years when Shaanxi people were famished and sold children, the government was to purchase them back and return them to their families.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered officials to buy back children sold in Shaanxi’s earlier famine and restore them to their parents.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幸邢昺第視疾，賜金帛。

translations.literal: Day renxu: he visited Xing Bing’s residence to inquire after his illness and gave gold and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he called on the ailing Xing Bing with gold and silk.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，幸元偁宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day yichou: he visited Prince of Shu’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he called at Prince of Shu’s sickroom.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申，溫仲舒卒。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingshen: Wen Zhongshu died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingshen: Wen Zhongshu died.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以右丞向敏中為工部尚書、資政殿大學士。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Right Vice Director Xiang Minzhong was made Minister of Works and Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Xiang Minzhong became Minister of Works and Zizheng Hall grand academician.

sentences.zh: 置龍圖閣學士，以直學士杜鎬為之。

translations.literal: Dragon Diagram Pavilion academicians were established; Direct Academician Du Hao was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Diagram academicians were created; Du Hao took the inaugural post.

sentences.zh: 詔南宮北宅大將軍以下，各勤講肄，諸子十歲以上並受經學書，勿令廢惰。

translations.literal: Edict: generals of the Southern and Northern Palaces and below were diligently to pursue study; all sons over ten were to receive the classics and must not be idle.
translations.idiomatic: Palace generals and princes’ sons over ten were ordered to study the classics without sloth.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，文武官、將校等三上表請祠汾陰后土。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: civil and military officials and officers three times submitted memorials requesting sacrifice at Fenyin to Queen of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou officials three times petitioned for a Fenyin sacrifice to Houtu.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未朔，詔：明年春有事于汾陰，州府長吏勿以修貢助祭煩民。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei new moon, edict: next spring there would be rites at Fenyin; circuit magistrates were not to trouble the people with tribute to assist the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingwei new moon: spring Fenyin rites were proclaimed and tribute levies for the ceremony were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 戊申，陳堯叟為祀汾陰經度制置使。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Chen Yaosou was made commissioner for planning the Fenyin sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Chen Yaosou took charge of Fenyin logistics.

sentences.zh: 己酉，王旦為祀汾陰大禮使，王欽若為禮儀使。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Wang Dan was made chief ritual commissioner for Fenyin; Wang Qinruo ritual commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Wang Dan headed the Fenyin rites and Wang Qinruo handled ritual.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔汾陰路禁弋獵，不得侵佔民田，如東封之制。

translations.literal: Day gengxu, edict: on the Fenyin route hunting was forbidden and the people’s fields must not be encroached, as for the eastern feng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Fenyin march matched eastern feng rules—no hunting, no seized fields.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以江南旱，詔轉運使決獄。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: because Jiangnan suffered drought, transport commissioners were ordered to decide cases.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Jiangnan drought sent transport commissioners to judge suits.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸元偁宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day renzi: he visited Prince of Shu’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he called again at Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 昇、洪、潤州屢火，遣使存撫，祠境內山川。

translations.literal: Sheng, Hong, and Run prefectures suffered repeated fires; envoys were sent to comfort them and sacrifice within their mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated fires in Sheng, Hong, and Run brought envoys to console the people and offer mountain-and-river rites.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賜占城國主馬及器甲。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the Champa king was given horses, armor, and vessels.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the king of Champa received horses, armor, and gifts.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸天駟監，賜從官馬。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: he visited the Imperial Horse Stud and gave accompanying officials horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he toured the royal stud and gifted horses to his escort.

sentences.zh: 解州池鹽不種自生。

translations.literal: Jie prefecture’s salt ponds produced salt without planting.
translations.idiomatic: Jiezhou’s salt pans yielded salt without sowing.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，給鄆州牧馬草地還民。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Yanzhou’s horse pasture land was returned to the people.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Yanzhou’s pasture was given back to farmers.

sentences.zh: 甲子，罷江、淮和糴，所在繫囚遞減一等，盜穀食者量行論決。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Jiang-Huai harmonized grain purchases were abolished; prisoners everywhere were reduced one grade; grain thieves were sentenced according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Jiang-Huai grain levies ended, jail terms were cut one degree, and grain theft was judged by scale.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，群臣五表上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the ministers five times submitted a honorific title; it was denied.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao five honorific petitions were refused.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔昇、洪、揚、廬州長吏兼安撫使。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: magistrates of Sheng, Hong, Yang, and Lu were made concurrent pacification commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Sheng, Hong, Yang, and Lu magistrates doubled as pacification commissioners.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以澄州團練使朱能為左龍武軍大將軍。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Zhu Neng, Chen prefecture training commissioner, was made Left Dragon Martial Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zhu Neng of Chenzhou became Left Dragon Martial Grand General.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，河中府父老千七百人來迎，上勞問之，賜以緡帛。

translations.literal: Day yihai: seventeen hundred elders of Hezhong prefecture came to welcome him; he addressed and questioned them and gave cash and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai seventeen hundred Hezhong elders came to greet the tour; he spoke with them and gave cash and silk.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，賜錢三十萬給故盧多遜子葬其父母。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao: three hundred thousand cash was given to bury the parents of the late Lu Duoxun’s son.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guimao: three hundred thousand cash buried the parents of Lu Duoxun’s son.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，作宗室座右銘賜諸王。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: admonitory inscriptions for the imperial clan were composed and given the princes.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai moral maxims for the clan were written and sent to every prince.

sentences.zh: 華州言父老二千餘人請幸西嶽。

translations.literal: Hua prefecture reported more than two thousand elders requesting a visit to the Western Peak.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou reported two thousand elders begging an imperial visit to the Western Peak.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，杖殺入內高品江守恩於鄭州，知州俞獻卿坐論救削一任。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Senior Palace Attendant Jiang Shouen was beaten to death at Zheng prefecture; prefect Yu Xianqing was demoted one tenure for arguing in his defense.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi eunuch Jiang Shouen was flogged to death at Zhengzhou; Yu Xianqing lost a term for pleading for him.

sentences.zh: 乙未，幸崇真資聖院視吳國長公主疾。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: he visited Chongzhen Zisheng Cloister to inquire after the Wu State elder princess’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he called at Chongzhen Cloister to see the Wu State elder princess.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，內出綏撫十六條，頒江、淮南安撫使。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: sixteen articles on soothing rule were issued from within and sent to Jiang-Huai pacification commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen sixteen pacification articles went to Jiang-Huai commissioners.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，契丹使耶律寧告征高麗。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinhai: Khitan envoy Yelü Ning announced a campaign against Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinhai: Khitan envoy Yelü Ning reported war on Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 河中民獲靈寶真文。

translations.literal: Hezhong people obtained a true writ of numinous treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhong folk found a sacred talisman text.

sentences.zh: 庚申，丁謂等上大中祥符封禪記。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Ding Wei and others presented the record of the Great Central Auspicious Response feng-shan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Ding Wei submitted the chronicle of the Great Central Auspicious Response feng-shan.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，遣內臣奉安宣祖、太祖聖容于二陵。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengyin: inner envoys were sent to install the sacred images of the Exalted Ancestor and Taizu at the two mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengyin: palace envoys placed Exalted Ancestor and Taizu portraits in both tombs.

sentences.zh: 乙未，甘州回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Ganzhou Uighurs sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Ganzhou Uighurs presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸太一宮。

translations.literal: Day jihai: he visited the Great Unity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he worshipped at the Great Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 陝州黃河清。

translations.literal: The Yellow River at Shan prefecture ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: Shanzhou’s Yellow River ran clear.

sentences.zh: 十二月，陝州黃河再清。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: the Yellow River at Shan prefecture ran clear again.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: Shanzhou’s Yellow River cleared again.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，集賢校理晏殊獻河清頌。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Academician Compiler Yan Shu presented an ode to the river’s clearing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Yan Shu offered a hymn to the clear river.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔天下貧民及漁採者過津渡勿算。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: poor people and fishermen crossing ferries were not to be charged.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou ferry tolls were waived for the poor and for fishers.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，告太廟。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the imperial temple was announced.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the court announced sacrifice at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 詔自今謁廟入東偏門。

translations.literal: Edict: from now on when visiting the temple one entered by the eastern side gate.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth temple visits used the eastern side gate.

sentences.zh: 以資政殿大學士向敏中權東京留守。

translations.literal: Zizheng Hall Grand Academician Xiang Minzhong was made acting eastern capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Minzhong became acting regent at the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，翰林學士李宗諤等上諸道圖經。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Hanlin academician Li Zong’e and others presented circuit maps and gazetteers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Zong’e and fellow Hanlin readers submitted provincial maps and gazetteers.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，謁玉清昭應宮。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: he paid homage at Jade Clarity Zhaoying Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he worshipped at Jade Clarity Zhaoying Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔沙門島流人特給口糧。

translations.literal: Day bingyin, edict: exiles on Shamen Island were specially given rations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Shamen Island convicts received extra grain rations.

sentences.zh: 己巳，作奉天庇民述示宰相。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the essay “Sheltering Heaven and Protecting the People” was composed and shown the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he wrote “Sheltering Heaven, Protecting the People” and showed it to his cabinet.

sentences.zh: 禁扈從人燔道路草木。

translations.literal: Those in the entourage were forbidden to burn roadside grass and trees.
translations.idiomatic: The escort was forbidden to burn grass or trees along the road.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以太宗御書賜交州李公蘊。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Taizong’s imperial calligraphy was bestowed on Jiaozhi’s Li Gongyun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Taizong’s own brushwork was sent to Li Gongyun in Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 是歲，龜茲、占城、交州來貢。

translations.literal: That year Kucha, Champa, and Jiaozhi sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute arrived from Kucha, Champa, and Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 陝西饑。

translations.literal: Shaanxi suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 江、淮南旱。

translations.literal: Jiang-Huai South suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: Drought gripped south Jiang-Huai.
